What is the JMI Entrance Exam?

Jamia Millia Islamia University conducts JMI Entrance Exam once every year for admissions to UG and PG courses offered by the university along with PG Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Diploma, MPhil, PhD, and certificate courses under various faculties/ departments/ centres such as Engineering , Architecture & Planning , Hospitality & Travel , Animation , Mass Communication , Humanities & Social Sciences , Languages, Commerce , Natural Sciences, Dentistry , Law , Fine Arts, Management Studies as well as Teaching & Education .
Details about JMI admissions through CUET, JEE, NATA and NEET scores are given here.

value: For B.A. & Diploma: Admission to B.A. Diploma courses at JMI are offered based on CUET scores. The National Testing Agency conduct this entrance exam every year , separately for UG and PG courses. After appearing for CUET exam, candidates have to apply on JMI admission portal.

For BTech: Admission to the B.Tech program of Jamia Millia Islamia is based on the final rank of JEE (Main) that is conducted by the National Test Agency (NTA). To be admitted to the BTech programme at JMI, candidates who submit the JEE Main online form must separately submit the Jamia Millia Islamia online application form at www.jmicoe.in.

For B.Arch: Similarly, candidates need to clear the National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA) conducted by the Council of Architecture, fill out the admission form for JMI and enter the NATA application number in the JMI form. The rank list is published based on the final rank secured in NATA, strictly as per merit and JMI Admission Policy. During the counselling sessions, candidates must bring the NATA scorecard for admission to the B.Arch program at JMI.

For BDS: Admissions to the B.D.S. program at JMI are based on the rank secured in NEET conducted by NTA. Candidates must choose Jamia Millia Islamia with the appropriate reservation category in the NEET application form. No separate form is required to be filled out at JMI or its website by the candidates.
For Ph.d: The schedule of admission tests for the Ph.D. program is notified separately.

JMI Entrance Exam Eligibility Criteria 2026
The JMI Entrance Exam eligibility criteria vary from course to course. The same for different courses is listed below -
MA Mass Communication

The eligibility criteria of the JMI Entrance Exam for this course state that a candidate who is a graduate in any discipline (in the 10+2+3 pattern) is eligible to apply for admission to the MA Mass Communication course at Jamia Millia Islamia University. Apart from this, the candidate should have secured at least 50 per cent marks in aggregate at the graduation level.
MA Mass Media (Hindi)

The JMI eligibility criteria for this course is that a candidate who has a graduate degree in any discipline can apply. But, the candidate must have at least 50 per cent marks in aggregate or equivalent CGPA grade from a university or institution recognized by JMI.
MA (Convergent Journalism) (Self-Financed)
AJK MCRC states that any candidate who is a graduate in any stream from a recognized college with a minimum of 50 per cent aggregate marks meets the eligibility criteria for this course admissions.
MA (Media & Governance)
The eligibility criteria for MA in Media & Governance states that a candidate must have at least 50 per cent in aggregate at graduate level in any discipline.
PG Diploma in Urdu Mass Media
For Urdu Mass Media course admissions, candidates should have cleared graduation with at least 45% marks in Urdu/Persian/Arabic.
PG Diploma in TV Journalism (Hindi Medium) (Self-Financed)
To be eligible for admission in this course, aspirants should have completed their graduation from a recognized college (in any stream) with at least 45 per cent aggregate marks.
PG Diploma in Broadcast Technology (Self-Financed)
The eligibility criteria for admission in this course state that any candidate who has completed his/ her graduation with a minimum aggregate of 50% in any subject is eligibile to apply.

However, a point to note is that only aspirants who have studied Physics , Chemistry and Mathematics in their Class XII are eligible to apply for admission. Also, the entrance test for this course will be in MCQs format only.
PG Diploma in Still Photography & Visual Communication (Self-Financed)
Candidates who have completed their graduation (10+2+3) in any discipline and have scored at least 50 per cent marks in aggregate are eligible to apply for admissions.
PG Diploma in Acting (Self-Financed)
Candidates with graduation in 10+2+3 format in any discipline can apply.
BA (Hons) (Mass Media Hindi)
The eligibility criteria for admissions in this course at Jamia Millia Islamia University states that interested candidates should have secured at least 50% aggregate marks in their Class 12.

To attain a good JMI score and get admission at their desired course, students must follow these JMI exam preparation tips .

value: Firstly, make sure you know the updated JMI syllabus and exam pattern.

Prepare from best books for JMI preparation and study material.
Practice from previous JMI Entrance Exam Question Papers and practice papers. These will help you understand the types of questions that might appear in test.

JMI Entrance Exam 2026 Answer Key

After the JMI entrance exam is conducted, Jamia Millia Islamia releases the JMI answer keys and response sheet to candidates who appeared for the test. Candidates can compare their responses with the JMI answer key and calculate their JMI 2026 scores. The answer key and candidates’ response sheets are made available online on the admission result page within three working days after the JMI entrance exam.

Candidates also get a window to raise challenges against the provisional answer key. Challenges against the JMI answer key can be submitted within 48 hours after the answer key is released. After all challenges have been received and considered, a final answer key is published by JMI.

Jamia Millia Islamia provides candidates an option to challenge their response sheet. Candidates can submit their objections against JMI answer key within 48 hours of its release. To submit their objection, candidates will have to pay INR 500 per programme to challenge the answer key. No grievance will be entertained by Jamia Millia Islamia without payment of fee.

Candidates who are not satisfied with the Jamia Millia Islamia's response sheet can raise their objections within a prescribed duration. To submit their objections, they will have to pay a fee of INR 500/- per programme to challenge. Candidates raising objections to two programmes will have to pay INR 1000. The JMI Entrance Exam answer key objection fee has to be paid online, through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, UPI, or Paytm.

After the answer key for JMI entrance exam is released, Jamia will open a window for candidates challenge it. The JMI answer key objection window is usually open for 48 hours. To submit their objection against answer key, candidates have to pay INR 200 per question. No challenge will be accepted without fee payment.

Jamia Millia Islamia University conducts JMI Entrance Exam once every year for admissions to UG and PG courses offered by the university along with PG Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Diploma, MPhil, PhD, and certificate courses under various faculties/ departments/ centres such as Engineering , Architecture & Planning , Hospitality & Travel , Animation , Mass Communication , Humanities & Social Sciences , Languages, Commerce , Natural Sciences, Dentistry , Law , Fine Arts, Management Studies as well as Teaching & Education .

What is UPCATET?

The UPCATET is a state-level entrance exam which is conducted once a year. The UPCATET exam is conducted to evaluate applicants' performance who wish to get admission into various undergraduate and postgraduate programs in the agricultural fields.

This entrance exam is conducted for candidates who possess a domicile of Uttar Pradesh State. These courses are offered at Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture & Technology , Kanpur; Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture and Technology , Meerut; Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology, Kumarganj, Banda University of Agriculture and Technology, Banda, etc.  The UPCATET exam is conducted for a three-hour duration, and the test mode is offline (pen & paper) only.

UPCATET asks only multiple‑choice questions (MCQs). Every question has four options. Students must choose the right answer. These questions help to analyse the speed and basic knowledge. This type of question is used for undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD courses. The difficulty changes, but the format remains the same. MCQs help students finish the exam on time and cover many topics in one test.

What is UPCATET?

The UPCATET is a state-level entrance exam which is conducted once a year. The UPCATET exam is conducted to evaluate applicants' performance who wish to get admission into various undergraduate and postgraduate programs in the agricultural fields.

This entrance exam is conducted for candidates who possess a domicile of Uttar Pradesh State. These courses are offered at Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture & Technology , Kanpur; Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture and Technology , Meerut; Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology, Kumarganj, Banda University of Agriculture and Technology, Banda, etc.  The UPCATET exam is conducted for a three-hour duration, and the test mode is offline (pen & paper) only.

UPCATET asks only multiple‑choice questions (MCQs). Every question has four options. Students must choose the right answer. These questions help to analyse the speed and basic knowledge. This type of question is used for undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD courses. The difficulty changes, but the format remains the same. MCQs help students finish the exam on time and cover many topics in one test.

If a candidate wants to take admission in next academic year, they must appear for IPU CET exam again and qualify in it to be eligible for admission. Candidates must know important dates related to IPU CET to avoid missing exam.

faqs.question: How does IPU release CET cutoff?
faqs.answer: The cutoff is made available on official GGSIPU website. Candidates can check cutoff by visiting university's admissions or counselling portal. Cutoffs are published in form of opening and closing ranks for various programmes, courses, and participating colleges. The steps to download the IPU CET Cutoff is given below. Visit official website of GGSIPU. Navigate to the Admissions or Counselling section. Look for a link to Cutoff or “=Counselling Cutoff under the respective course. faqs.question: Is the IPU CET cutoff the same for all colleges and programmes?
faqs.answer: No, IPU CET cutoff varies for different programmes and colleges affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. Each college and programme may have its own cutoff based on number of seats available and  popularity of programme. It is important to check cutoff specifically for programme and college you are interested in.

faqs.question: How will I know that I have scored above the IPU CET cutoff or not?
faqs.answer: To find if you have scored above IPU CET cutoff or not, you need to compare your actual marks or rank with  officially released cutoff marks by Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) or respective authorities responsible for conducting examination. IPU CET cutoff marks are usually published on official website of university or conducting authority. Visit official website and look for Cutoff section or latest notification related to exam. The cutoff marks are typically announced along with exam results or during admission process.

faqs.question: What is the criteria for appearing in IPU CET B.Tech counselling?
faqs.answer: Candidates should have a valid JEE Main scorecard to apply for IPU CET B.Tech counselling. Admission to the B.Tech course is given based on JEE Main score, followed by IPU CET counselling. The link for IPU CET 2026 counselling registration and choice filling is made available online on the official website at ipu. admissions. nic. in. faqs.question: How is IPU CET counselling conducted?

faqs.question: For which non-medical programmes the score of the National Level Test is considered for admission?

faqs.question: What is the code of B.Tech, B.Tech LE (Diploma), B.Tech, LE B.Sc. and B.Tech (Biotechnology) for IPU CET?

faqs.question: Is the IPU CET counselling fee refundable?
faqs.answer: No, the IPU CET counselling fee of 1,000 is non-refundable. This applies even if: You withdraw from the counselling process. You do not get a seat. You decide not to participate in subsequent rounds of counselling. However, if you pay the part academic fee (usually 40,000) after seat allotment, that amount may be refundable if you withdraw within specified deadlines. Always check official IPU counselling guidelines for refund policies.

faqs.question: Can the IPU CET Applications filled offline?
faqs.answer: No. There is no such provision for filling the IPU CET application form offline. Students will have to register and submit an application form online. Registration can be done on the admission portal, ipu.admissions.nic.in .

faqs.question: Can the Eligibility for the IPU CET be changed?
faqs.answer: IPU CET eligibility criteria have been released on the official website. There are no changes in the eligibility of IPU CET 2026. However, if any changes are made, they will be announced online.

faqs.question: Can I crack IPU CET through Self Study?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates can crack the IPU CET through self-study. There is no need of coaching class for IPU CET. The syllabus will be based on what the candidates have studied in the previous course.

faqs.question: Is it compulsory to attempt the English section of IPU CET BTech Lateral Entry?
faqs.answer: Yes.  It is compulsory to attend all the sections. 20% of the questions will be in English. The candidates must definitely attempt the questions from english.

faqs.answer: IPU CET application form released. Last date to apply for exam will be in March 31, 2026. Application form cannot be submiited without paying application fee. IPU CET 2026 application steps are registration, filling application form, uploading documents, fee payment and submission.

faqs.question: In which mode should the IPU CET application fee payment made?
faqs.answer: IPU CET application fee is INR 2500. The fee can be paid online. IPU CET 2026 application form can be filled after paying application fee. After registration, candidates will receive unique ID and Password. Candidates must use these login details to open application form. Candidates can fill IPU CET application form after registration.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in the IPU CET exam for B.Tech lateral entry and B.Tech (Bio-Technology) admission?
faqs.answer: IPU CET question paper will include 100 questions. Each question will have four answer options. Candidates must choose correct answer from options given. Question paper is for 400 marks.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in IPU CET?
faqs.answer: In IPU CET  there is negative marking. This means one mark is reduced for each incorrect response. Marks are not deducted for unanswered questions. This means that if a candidate leaves a question unanswered, no marks are deducted.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of IPU CET examination?
faqs.answer: In IPU CET for each correct answer, four marks will be given, and for each incorrect answer, one mark will be reduced. There are no marks deducted for unanswered questions. Examination is conducted for 2 hours 30 minutes. Candidates must know the marking scheme before attempting exam.

faqs.question: Is there any provision for conducting the IPU CET exam twice in a year?
faqs.answer: No, IPU CET 2026 will not be conducted twice. It will be conducted only once a year for each course. The exam dates will be from March 2026 to May 2026 for various courses.

faqs.question: What are the topics included for IPU CET 2026 BTech (Biotechnology)?
faqs.answer: The topics included for IPU CET BTech (Biotechnology) are Physics - 20%, Chemistry - 20% Mathematics - 20% Biology - 40% or Biotechnology - 40%.

faqs.question: Where can I check the IPU CET syllabus?
faqs.answer: The official syllabus will not be made public by IPU CET University. The IPU CET 2026 undergraduate syllabus will be based on the Class 11 and 12 curriculum. It is recommended that candidates review and go over every topic and concept they studied in Classes 11 and 12.

faqs.question: What is the weightage given for each topic in IPU CET for Lateral Entry to BTech course for Diploma Holders?
faqs.answer: The weightage given for the various topics is Applied Mechanics- (25%) Applied Mathematics- (25%) Computer Awareness and Physics / Chemistry Knowledge- (25%) Analytical and Logical Reasoning- (25%). .

faqs.question: What are the topics included in the syllabus for Lateral Entry BTech for Diploma Holders in IPU CET?
faqs.answer: The subjects included for Lateral Entry B.Tech for Diploma Holders in IPU CET are Applied Mechanics Applied Mathematics Computer Awareness and Physics / Chemistry Knowledge Analytical and Logical Reasoning.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BTech admission in IP University?
faqs.answer: Candidate must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with a minimum of 55% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. University will not conduct a separate IPU CET for admission to BTech course. The admission to BTech course is based on JEE Main marks. Candidates who want to join Engineering must have a valid JEE Main score.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to apply for IPU CET B.Tech Diploma lateral entry?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed three years Diploma in relevant subject with a minimum of 60% marks. Appeared in IPU CET and name must be in merit list/rank list. Candidates must have cleared Mathematics as a subject at Class 12 level or should have studied Mathematics as a subject in first year of the Diploma programme. Candidates must not have any backlog in any of the subjects in the qualifying examination.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to apply for IPU CET BTech BSc Lateral entry?
faqs.answer: For Lateral Entry BTech, BSc Candidates should have passed BSc. With Mathematics as a subject. The candidates must have scored a minimum of 60% marks from any recognised University. The candidates should have appeared in the IPU CET. The name of the candidate should be there in the merit list/rank list.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria to participate in the IPU CET?
faqs.answer: IPU CET 2026 eligibility criteria are different for each course. Candidates can check the eligibility for BTech Lateral Entry. BTech (Lateral Entry) for Diploma holders Candidates must have passed a Diploma to apply for BTech Lateral Entry. They must have studied Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. BTech (Lateral Entry) for BSc Graduates Candidates must have passed a BSc in Physics or Mathematics to apply for BTech Lateral Entry. They must have studied Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

faqs.question: Can I get the IPU CET admit card through offline mode?
faqs.answer: The official website is the only platform for admit cards. The IPU CET Admit Card will not be posted elsewhere. Once application form is submitted, IPU CET Admit Card will be accessible. The admit card available approximately one week before examination date. In cases where a candidate has opted for multiple exams, separate IPU CET Admit Cards will be issued for each respective exam.

faqs.question: Who will release the IP University admit card?
faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIU) is responsible for releasing IPU CET admit card. IPU CET admit card will be available on official website. The CET admit card can be downloaded by entering credentials like mobile number and date of birth.

faqs.question: When will the admit card for IPU CET be released?
faqs.answer: IPU CET admit card 2026 will be released on official webiste. The IPU CET exam will be conducted from April 2026 to May 2026. The admit card is usually released in April 2026. Candidates must check this space for more updates on IPU CET 2026.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to keep the hall ticket for IPU CET after the completion of the examination?
faqs.answer: IPU CET admit card is required till admission is completed. Admit Card has information such as roll number, exam centre details, and other instructions. The hall ticket serves as proof of registration and eligibility for exam.

faqs.question: What are the exam dates for IPU CET?
faqs.answer: The Indraprastha University Common Entrance Test (IPU CET) 2026 will be conducted by Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) from April 25, 2026 to May 17, 2026, for various undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. IPU CET BTech (Biotechnology) will be conducted from April 2026.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to carry a printed copy of the IPU CET admit card to the exam centre?
faqs.answer: Yes, printed copy of IPU CET admit card must be taken to exam centre. The admit card is proof of eligibility and registration for IPU CET. It will have information such as roll number, exam centre details, and instructions.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund of the application fee if I don't appear for the IPU CET 2026 exam?
faqs.answer: No, the application fee once paid is non-refundable. The candidates must try to appear for the exam without fail. Admission to various courses at Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University is based on IPU CET 2026 score. The candidates willing to join a course at the university must take the exam.

faqs.question: What are the topics included for IPU CET 2026 BTech (Biotechnology)?
faqs.answer: The topics included for IPU CET BTech (Biotechnology) are Physics - 20%, Chemistry - 20% Mathematics - 20% Biology - 40% or Biotechnology - 40%.

faqs.question: What details are required to check IPU CET result?
faqs.answer: No details are required to check IPU CET result. IPU CET result is released in the form of rank list in PDF format. Candidates will be called for counselling based on their scores in IPU CET 2026. Following steps should be followed to check IPU CET 2026 result. Go to ipu. ac. Click on result link. Candidates will have to select their subject. IPU CET result will open in form of a rank list To save rank list PDF, candidates can click on download icon/button. Wait until file downloads successfully. After that, candidates can open IPU CET 2026 rank list and search for their names.

faqs.question: When will the result of the IPU CET be declared?
faqs.answer: IPU CET result 2026 will be declared a few days post conclusion of the exam. The result of LE-BTech for Diploma Holder (CET Code - 128), LE-BTech for BSc Holders (CET Code - 129) and BioTechnology (CET Code - 130) will be released on the official website. The counselling process starts after the results were out.

faqs.question: Is it possible to download the IPU CET result again in case it is misplaced?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is possible to download IPU CET result again if it goes missing. Result will be available on official website. They must click on result link and download result using login credentials. IPU CET result will be announced on different days for different courses.

faqs.question: What details are mentioned in IPU CET result?
faqs.answer: The IPU CET 2026 result typically includes: Candidate’s Name Roll Number Rank/Score Course Applied Qualifying Status

faqs.question: What is the validity of the IPU CET result?
faqs.answer: The validity of IPU CET 2026 result is for current academic year. Candidates must apply for admission to desired course in same academic year. If a candidate wants to take admission in next academic year, they must appear for IPU CET exam again and qualify in it to be eligible for admission. Candidates must know important dates related to IPU CET to avoid missing exam.

faqs.question: What details are mentioned in IPU CET result?
faqs.answer: The IPU CET 2026 result typically includes: Candidate’s Name Roll Number Rank/Score Course Applied Qualifying Status

faqs.question: Are the IPU CET result of all the courses declared at the same time?
faqs.answer: IPU CET results of the different courses will be released separately on different dates. The candidates must check the official website regularly to check for the result. The results link will be updated here. The results of LE-BTech for Diploma Holders (CET Code - 128), LE-BTech for BSc Holders (CET Code - 129), and BioTechnology (CET Code - 130) will be in June 2026, tentatively. The exam dates can be expected in May and June 2026.

faqs.question: How does IPU release CET cutoff?
faqs.answer: The cutoff is made available on official GGSIPU website. Candidates can check cutoff by visiting university's admissions or counselling portal. Cutoffs are published in form of opening and closing ranks for various programmes, courses, and participating colleges. The steps to download the IPU CET Cutoff is given below. Visit official website of GGSIPU. Navigate to the Admissions or Counselling section. Look for a link to Cutoff or “=Counselling Cutoff under the respective course. Make sure to download the cutoff list for your reference and keep track of changes during multiple counselling rounds

faqs.question: What is the criteria for appearing in IPU CET B.Tech counselling?
faqs.answer: Candidates should have a valid JEE Main scorecard to apply for IPU CET B.Tech counselling. Admission to the B.Tech course is given based on JEE Main score, followed by IPU CET counselling. The link for IPU CET 2026 counselling registration and choice filling is made available online on the official website at ipu. admissions. nic. in. To participate in the IPU CET 2026 counselling, candidates need to pay the counselling participation fee.

faqs.question: How is IPU CET counselling conducted?
faqs.answer: IPU CET counselling is being conducted in online mode. The candidates are allotted seats during IPU CET counselling. Candidates are called for counselling based on their JEE Main score for the B.Tech programme. For B.Tech (Biotechnology), Lateral Entry to B.Tech programmes for Diploma holders and Lateral Entry to B.Tech programmes for B.Sc. Graduates, candidates are called for counselling based on IPU CET score.

faqs.question: Which documents are required at the time of IPU CET document verification?
faqs.answer: The documents required for verification are JEE Main admit card & result (for B.Tech course), IPU CET 2026 score card (B.Tech (BioTechnology), Lateral Entry to B.Tech Programmes for B.Sc. Graduates, Lateral Entry to B.Tech Programmes for Diploma holders) caste category Certificate admission receipt, provisional allotment letter, and conduct Certificate. The candidates must make sure that all the documents are provided during document verification. After confirmation of the seats, candidates have to go through the document verification process.

faqs.question: What are the steps to apply for the counselling session at IPU following the IPU CET exam?
faqs.answer: The registration for counselling will begin after exam results are out. Once registration for counselling is open, candidates must complete registration formalities. Then candidates will be able to proceed with selection of preferred choices.

faqs.question: For which non-medical programmes the score of the National Level Test is considered for admission?
faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University considers the merit/score of the National Level Test score conducted by agencies other than the University for admission to the B.Tech LL.B. MCA LL. M. and MBA. Only applicants who have passed the relevant National Level Test will be considered for admission through the university's counselling process if they meet the eligibility and admission requirements. It's crucial that applicants accurately enter their National Level Test application number/registration number in the Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University's application form.

faqs.question: Is the IPU CET counselling fee refundable?
faqs.answer: No, the IPU CET counselling fee of 1,000 is non-refundable. This applies even if: You withdraw from the counselling process. You do not get a seat. You decide not to participate in subsequent rounds of counselling. However, if you pay the part academic fee (usually 40,000) after seat allotment, that amount may be refundable if you withdraw within specified deadlines. Always check official IPU counselling guidelines for refund policies.

faqs.question: How frequently IPU CET exam is conducted in a year?
faqs.answer: IPU CET is conducted only one time in a year for admission of the candidates. The exam is conducted for admission to various courses at Guru Govind Singh Indraprastha University. IPU CET is conducted only for some of courses that are not covered under national level entrance exams. It is recommended to check official website of GGSIPU for latest updates on IPU CET exam schedule.

faqs.question: What is the code of B.Tech, B.Tech LE (Diploma), B.Tech, LE B.Sc. and B.Tech (Biotechnology) for IPU CET?
faqs.answer: The code of B.Tech LE (Diploma) is 128, B.Tech LE B.Sc. Is 129, B.Tech (Biotechnology) is 130, and B.Tech is 131.

faqs.question: Can the IPU CET Applications filled offline?
faqs.answer: No. There is no such provision for filling the IPU CET application form offline. Students will have to register and submit an application form online. Registration can be done on the admission portal, ipu.admissions.nic.in .

faqs.question: Can the Eligibility for the IPU CET be changed?
faqs.answer: IPU CET eligibility criteria have been released on the official website. There are no changes in the eligibility of IPU CET 2026. However, if any changes are made, they will be announced online.

faqs.question: Can I crack IPU CET through Self Study?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates can crack the IPU CET through self-study. There is no need of coaching class for IPU CET. The syllabus will be based on what the candidates have studied in the previous course.

faqs.question: Is it compulsory to attempt the English section of IPU CET BTech Lateral Entry?
faqs.answer: Yes.  It is compulsory to attend all the sections. 20% of the questions will be in English. The candidates must definitely attempt the questions from english.

blocks.value: CIEAT 2026: The exam conducting body, Crescent Institute of Science and Technology, is expected to announce CIEAT Exam Dates 2026 soon. Along with the notification, the exam body will also release the CIEAT Application Form 2026 , and candidates will be able to apply using the direct link given below on this page, as well as from the official website.

The CIEAT 2026 exam will be conducted online as a home-based, remote proctored exam for a time duration of 2 hours. The test will have a total of 100 multiple-choice questions with no negative marking. As per the CIEAT Exam Pattern 2026 there will be 50 questions from Mathematics/Biology and 25 each from Physics and Chemistry. Candidates appearing for admission to B.Tech programs in Biotechnology have to take Biology instead of Mathematics in the exam. The CIEAT Syllabus 2026 includes standard class 11 and 12 board topics of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology. Candidates preparing for CIEAT 2026 can study as per their board exam syllabus. What is CIEAT?

The Crescent Institute Engineering Admission Test (CIEAT) is conducted by the B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology to shortlist candidates for admission in B.Tech programs offered by the institute. B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology is a Deemed University located in Chennai and offers B.Tech courses in a total of 15 disciplines. The CiEAT exam is conducted every year online as a Computer Based Test. The Candidates will be shortlisted for admission based on their merit in the qualifying examination and marks obtained in the CIEAT 2026.

Admission to BTech courses at B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology is also based on JEE Main scores. Candidates having a valid score in JEE Main 2026 will be eligible for direct admission in B.Tech courses in the institute without appearing in CIEAT 2026. More details about the CIEAT 2026 admission process, exam dates, application form, syllabus, exam pattern, and other important details can be checked here.
The selection of candidates in CIEAT is solely based on the basis of CIEAT exam and JEE Main scores.

value: Adjoint, Inverse-Properties, Computation of inverses, solution of a system of linear equations by matrix inversion method. Scalar Product–Angle between two vectors, properties of scalar product, applications of dot products. Vector Product - Right-handed and left-handed systems, properties of vector product, applications of the cross product. Product of three vectors - Scalar triple product, properties of the scalar triple product, vector triple product, vector product of four vectors, scalar product of four-vectors. Lines - Equation of a straight line passing through a given point and parallel to a given vector, passing through two given points (derivations are not required). The angle between two lines. Skew lines - The shortest distance between two lines, condition for two lines to intersect, point of intersection, collinearity of three points. Planes - Equation of a plane (derivations are not required), passing through a given point and perpendicular to a vector, given the distance from the origin and unit normal, passing through a given point and parallel to two given vectors, passing through two given points and parallel to a given vector, passing through three given non-collinear points, passing through the line of intersection of two given planes, the distance between a point and a plane, the plane which contains two given lines, the angle between two given planes, the angle between a line and a plane. Derivative as a rate measure - the rate of change - velocity -acceleration - related rates - Derivative as a measure of slope - tangent, normal and angle between curves. Maxima and Minima. Mean value theorem - Rolle’s Theorem - Lagrange Mean Value Theorem - Taylor’s and Maclaurin’s series, l’ Hôpital’s Rule, stationary points - increasing, decreasing, maxima, minima, concavity convexity, points of inflexion.

Errors and approximations- absolute, relative, percentage errors, curve tracing, partial derivatives - Euler’s theorem. Integral Calculus & its Applications Properties of definite integrals, reduction formulae for sinnx and cosnx (only results), Area, length, volume and surface area.

Formation of differential equations, order and degree, solving differential equations (1st order) - variable separable homogeneous, linear equations. Second-order linear equations with constant coefficients f(x) = emx, sin mx, cos mx, x, x2.
Mathematical Logic - Logical statements, connectives, truth tables, Tautologies.
Binary Operations - Semi groups - monoids, groups (Problems and simple properties only), order of a group, order of an element.
Random Variable, Probability density function, distribution function, mathematical expectation, variance, Discrete Distributions - Binomial, Poisson, Continuous Distribution - Normal distribution.

Concept of space, mass, time – Frame of references. The special theory of relativity – Relativity of length, time and mass with velocity – (E = mc2).

blocks.value: CIEAT 2026: The exam conducting body, Crescent Institute of Science and Technology, is expected to announce CIEAT Exam Dates 2026 soon. The exam dates will be mentioned in its notification. Along with the notification, the exam body will also release the CIEAT Application Form 2026 , and candidates will be able to apply using the direct link given below on this page, as well as from the official website.

The CIEAT 2026 exam will be conducted online as a home-based, remote proctored exam for a time duration of 2 hours. The test will have a total of 100 multiple-choice questions with no negative marking. As per the CIEAT Exam Pattern 2026 there will be 50 questions from Mathematics/Biology and 25 each from Physics and Chemistry. Candidates appearing for admission to B.Tech programs in Biotechnology have to take Biology instead of Mathematics in the exam. The CIEAT Syllabus 2026 includes standard class 11 and 12 board topics of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology. Candidates preparing for CIEAT 2026 can study as per their board exam syllabus. The difficulty level of the CIEAT exam is similar to the board exams of the intermediate class.
What is CIEAT?

The Crescent Institute Engineering Admission Test (CIEAT) is conducted by the B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology to shortlist candidates for admission in B.Tech programs offered by the institute. B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology is a Deemed University located in Chennai and offers B.Tech courses in a total of 15 disciplines. The CiEAT exam is conducted every year online as a Computer Based Test. The Candidates will be shortlisted for admission based on their merit in the qualifying examination and marks obtained in the CIEAT 2026.

Admission to BTech courses at B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology is also based on JEE Main scores. Candidates having a valid score in JEE Main 2026 will be eligible for direct admission in B.Tech courses in the institute without appearing in CIEAT 2026. More details about the CIEAT 2026 admission process, exam dates, application form, syllabus, exam pattern, and other important details can be checked here.
The selection of candidates in CIEAT is solely based on the basis of CIEAT exam and JEE Main scores.
The CIEAT 2026 exam date is not released as of now. As per the past year dates, the CIEAT exam will be conducted in April 2026 at Chennai centres as well as in other cities/centres.
CIEAT 2026 application form will be released in a few days. As of now there are no dates as to when the application form will be released.

blocks.value: CIEAT 2026 Application Form
The exam body, B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai, will release the application form of CIEAT 2026.

Candidates meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will be able to apply for B.Tech admission. The complete application procedure includes online registration, filling the details form, uploading scanned images of photograph, signature and payment of the application fees.

Candidates need to complete all steps involved in filling application form failing which their application will not be considered. The step by step guide to fill CIEAT application form 2026 is given below
How to Fill CIEAT Application Form

value: Click on CIEAT 2026 Application form link
Fill in the required details and click on the Register button to complete the registration process
After registration, candidates have to fill the detailed application form with all the required information
Upload scanned images of photo and signature
Pay application fees online using a credit/debit card or internet banking

blocks.value: ⇒ Apply for CIEAT 2026 here - (Link to be shared soon)

The CIEAT application form will be automatically submitted after successfully paying the application fees. Candidates need to download and take a printout of their filled application form and keep it safe until the completion of the admission process.
CIEAT 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Before beginning to fill the application form for CIEAT 2026, candidates must go through the eligibility criteria in detail. Candidates must fulfill CIEAT eligibility criteria for BTech to fill the application form failing which their application will not be considered for admission. Read the eligibility criteria to apply for the CIEAT 2026 BTech program below:

value: Candidates should have passed/appeared in Class 12 (HSC/ CBSE /ICS etc.) or any equivalent exam
Candidates must have secured a minimum aggregate of 50% in Maths/ Biology, Physics and Chemistry
Candidates interested in studying BTech Biotechnology should have studied Biology as one of the subjects
Candidates should be born on or after July 1, 2003

blocks.value: It is advised that candidates must ensure their eligibility before filling the application form. The complete details about the eligibility criteria is mentioned in the CIEAT 2026 information brochure.
To apply for CIEAT, candidates should have born on or after July 1,  2003.
To apply for CIEAT, Candidates must have passed class 12 with a minimum aggregate of 50% of marks in Mathematics/ Biology, Physics and Chemistry.
CIEAT 2026 Syllabus

The syllabus of the CIEAT 2026 exam has been released by the institute. CIEAT syllabus includes class 11 and 12 Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology topics. Candidates can check here the complete subject-wise list of topics that will be asked in the CIEAT 2026 exam.

value: Electrostatics; Current Electricity; Effects of Electric Current; Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Current; Electromagnetic Waves and Wave Optics; Atomic Physics; Dual Nature of Radiation And Matter–relativity; Semiconductor Devices and their Applications; Nuclear Physics; Communication Systems

Inorganic Chemistry: Atomic Structure; Periodic Classification; P, d, f – Block Elements; Coordination Compounds and Bio-Coordination Compounds; Nuclear Chemistry Physical Chemistry: Solid State; Thermodynamics; Chemical Equilibrium; Chemical Kinetics; Surface Chemistry; Electrochemistry Organic Chemistry: Isomerism; Hydroxy Derivatives; Ethers; Carboxylic Acids; Organic Nitrogen Compounds; Biomolecules

Applications of Matrices and Determinants; Vector Algebra; Complex Numbers; Analytical Geometry; Differential Calculus and its Applications; Differential Equations; Discrete Mathematics; Probability Distributions; Binary Operations
Taxonomy of Angiosperms; Plant anatomy; Cell biology and genetics; Biotechnology; Plant physiology; Biology in human welfare

CIEAT Exam Pattern 2026

value: Online as a Computer Based Test (CBT) - Remote Proctored Home Based
Physics Chemistry Mathematics/Biology Biology has to be taken by only candidates appearing for BTech Biotechnology

blocks.value: CIEAT 2026 Admit Card
How to Download CIEAT Admit Card

value: Click on the CIEAT admit card download link
Login using the application number and password
Download the admit card and take its printout

blocks.value: After downloading, candidates should check and verify all the details mentioned in their CIEAT hall ticket. In case any mismatch in information is found, candidates need to contact the institute for the rectification of errors before the exam.
CIEAT 2026 Exam Centres

The examination will be conducted in twenty cities of the country. Candidates can check the names of the cities and then select an appropriate exam centre so that they can appear in the exam without facing any inconvenience. The list of the CIEAT exam centres is available below.
CIEAT Question Papers 2026

The CIEAT 2026 exam will be conducted online as a Computer Based Test. Candidates are NOT provided with a physical (offline) copy of the CIEAT question papers after the exam. The institute might release the question papers of CIEAT 2026 online on the institute website after the conclusion of the exam.

Candidates who will appear in the CIEAT 2026 exam will be able to download their question papers by login into the website. Previous year papers of CIEAT can be used by aspirants who will be appearing in the exam in the upcoming days to evaluate the difficulty level, subject-wise weightage of topics and overall difficulty level of the exam.
CIEAT 2026 Answer Key

The answer key of CIEAT is NOT released by the institute. B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology did not release the answer key in previous years. If released by the institute, candidates will be provided here with the direct link to check the CIEAT answer key 2026. Candidates can use the CIEAT answer key to calculate their expected score in the exam before the announcement of the results.
CIEAT 2026 Result

B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology will declare the CIEAT result tentatively in May. Results will be announced online on the institute's website. Candidates need to log in to the website using their application number and password to check their CIEAT result 2026 scorecard.

Details about the subject-wise marks secured by the candidates will be mentioned in the CIEAT 2026 result. Candidates need to download and take a printout of their scorecard as it will be required at the time of counselling and admission process.
How to Check CIEAT Result 2026

value: Login using application number and password
Upon successful login, the scorecard will be displayed on the screen

blocks.value: It is advised that students keep safe their scorecards until the completion of the counselling and admission process. Candidates who will qualify the exam will be eligible for admission in the institute.
CIEAT 2026 Counselling

The counselling and admission process will start after the declaration of the results. Details about the counselling procedure and the schedule can be checked on the institute website after the result. CIEAT counselling 2026 will be conducted online. All qualified candidates will be required to register online to participate in the counselling.

The allotment of seats will be done online based on marks secured by the candidates in CIEAT 2026 and the qualifying exam/class 12. After seat allotment, candidates need to confirm their admission and deposit the course fees online. Subsequently, candidates need to report to the institute for the completion of the admission process.
CIEAT Fee Structure

value: Tuition Fee per Semester based on % of marks in Maths, Physics & Chemistry (INR)

blocks.value: BEEE 2026 Preparation : Get complete preparation tips along with exam pattern, syllabus details of BEEE 2026 . The admission test will comprise questions with easy to moderate level questions. Syllabus is pretty much similar to class 12th. To achieve a good score in BEEE, it is important to have a practical timetable with good understanding of concepts and fundamentals. Read below to know more about BEEE 2026 preparation tips .
BEEE 2026 Preparation Tips
Get familiar with syllabus

First, go through syllabus. Pick one to two topics (as per your convinience) and start studying. Also, follow notes and textbooks for concept building. Make short notes for revision purposes. Keep a note of topics that you find difficult to understand and put extra efforts into it.
BEEE Exam Pattern 2026

value: One mark will be given for every correct answer. No negative marking

blocks.value: Practice Mock Tests

To stay acquainted with the exam pattern and difficulty level, take mock test regularly. Solving one to two mock test will improve accuracy to attempt questions and time management. Keep a record of your performances to keep track on progress.
Revise Many Times and Give Rest to Your Body
Do not forget to revise. Make a habit of revising every topic daily so that you stay well connected with the fundamentals. Make short notes for quick revision and maintain it regularly.
In the middle of your prep, invest in reading books, meditation, and listen to music. Eat healthy and get good amount of sleep, because behind good rank, taking care of health is also important.

SUJEE 2026 Admission Process
Candidates can check here complete details about the admission process of Sandip University.
Stage 1: Apply for SU JEE 2026 Online (OR) Purchase the SU JEE application form from designated centres / University Office.
Candidates can apply for SU JEE 2026 on official website or collect SU JEE application form from University.

Students can collect application forms from University's office by paying cash of INR 750 or a demand draft drawn in favour of "Sandip University". Aspirants are required to write their Name, Father’s Name, Contact Number, and Course on the back of the DD.
Aspirants can also download prospectus and the application fee from the website. They need to pay INR 750 while submitting the application form.
Stage 2: Submit the duly filled Application Form

After filling details, aspirants need to submit SUJEE application form at any of the centres / University offices. If a student has appeared for any of national exams like JEE/UPSEE/CAT/MAT/SAT/GMAT/ENAT/EMAT, they would be required to submit the scores of the same.
Stage 3: Appear for SU JEE and GDPI

After successfully submitting application form, aspirants need to appear for SU JEE. Admissions to Non-Professional Courses are done on a merit basis. For some courses, aspirants will also have to appear for Group Discussions and Personal Interviews.
Stage 4: Check SU JEE results
SU JEE results will be declared on official website of the University. The result will have a candidate's merit position, scorecard with total marks, and marks obtained in each subject.
Stage 5: Complete all the admission formalities and deposit the requisite fee.

Once aspirants are selected, they need to complete all admission formalities and deposit the requisite fee. The fee can be paid Demand Draft / Cheque / Debit Card / Credit Card / Net banking at the fee counter.
Stage 6: Commencement of classes
After all admission formalities are complete, class commencement schedule will be published on notice board and/or university website.

SUJEE 2026 Admission Process
Candidates can check here complete details about the admission process of Sandip University.
Stage 1: Apply for SU JEE 2026 Online (OR) Purchase the SU JEE application form from designated centres / University Office.
Candidates can apply for SU JEE 2026 on official website or collect SU JEE application form from University.

Students can collect application forms from University's office by paying cash of INR 750 or a demand draft drawn in favour of "Sandip University". Aspirants are required to write their Name, Father’s Name, Contact Number, and Course on the back of the DD.
Aspirants can also download prospectus and the application fee from the website. They need to pay INR 750 while submitting the application form.
Stage 2: Submit the duly filled Application Form

After filling details, aspirants need to submit SUJEE application form at any of the centres / University offices. If a student has appeared for any of national exams like JEE/UPSEE/CAT/MAT/SAT/GMAT/ENAT/EMAT, they would be required to submit the scores of the same.
Stage 3: Appear for SU JEE and GDPI

After successfully submitting application form, aspirants need to appear for SU JEE. Admissions to Non-Professional Courses are done on a merit basis. For some courses, aspirants will also have to appear for Group Discussions and Personal Interviews.
Stage 4: Check SU JEE results
SU JEE results will be declared on official website of the University. The result will have a candidate's merit position, scorecard with total marks, and marks obtained in each subject.
Stage 5: Complete all the admission formalities and deposit the requisite fee.

Once aspirants are selected, they need to complete all admission formalities and deposit the requisite fee. The fee can be paid Demand Draft / Cheque / Debit Card / Credit Card / Net banking at the fee counter.
Stage 6: Commencement of classes
After all admission formalities are complete, class commencement schedule will be published on notice board and/or university website.

What is AJU CET?

Arka Jain University, which is a private university located in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand India conducts the AJU CET exam annually. The objective of the AJUCET is to shortlist students for UG, PG, and PhD programs at the university's campus. Arka Jain University was established under Arka Jain University Act on 14 July 2017 . It is affiliated with UGC. The school of pharmacy is approved by Pharmacy Council of India and school of law is approved by Bar Council of India.

AJU is one of most popular private universities providing qualify education, best facilities, experienced faculty members and a great campus life for students to prosper, not just academically but in overall.

The AJU CET 2025 is conducted by the Arka Jain University, Jharkhand. The exam body prescribes the syllabus, exam pattern, and eligibility criteria for all courses. It also manages application forms, admit cards, results, and counselling processes. The university is responsible for publishing official updates on its website.

All official notifications and updates regarding AJU CET 2025 are published on the university's official website: ajucet.arkajainuniversity.ac.in . Candidates should regularly visit the website to stay updated on application deadlines, admit cards, syllabus, and results.

The AJU CET 2025 (Arka Jain University Common Entrance Test) is a national-level entrance exam which is conducted by the Arka Jain University for admission of shortlisted candidates into UG, PG, and PhD programs for the 2025-26 academic session. The test evaluates candidates' subject knowledge and aptitude. It is mandatory for most courses, except where exemptions apply. AJU CET is conducted online in a single shift.

It's important to appear on the date mentioned on the admit card.

What is AJU CET?

Arka Jain University, which is a private university located in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand India conducts the AJU CET exam annually. The objective of the AJUCET is to shortlist students for UG, PG, and PhD programs at the university's campus. Arka Jain University was established under Arka Jain University Act on 14 July 2017 . It is affiliated with UGC. The school of pharmacy is approved by Pharmacy Council of India and school of law is approved by Bar Council of India.

AJU is one of most popular private universities providing qualify education, best facilities, experienced faculty members and a great campus life for students to prosper, not just academically but in overall.

The AJU CET 2025 is conducted by the Arka Jain University, Jharkhand. The exam body prescribes the syllabus, exam pattern, and eligibility criteria for all courses. It also manages application forms, admit cards, results, and counselling processes. The university is responsible for publishing official updates on its website.

All official notifications and updates regarding AJU CET 2025 are published on the university's official website: ajucet.arkajainuniversity.ac.in . Candidates should regularly visit the website to stay updated on application deadlines, admit cards, syllabus, and results.

The AJU CET 2025 (Arka Jain University Common Entrance Test) is a national-level entrance exam which is conducted by the Arka Jain University for admission of shortlisted candidates into UG, PG, and PhD programs for the 2025-26 academic session. The test evaluates candidates' subject knowledge and aptitude. It is mandatory for most courses, except where exemptions apply. AJU CET is conducted online in a single shift.

No, Arka Jain University does not conduct any re-examination for AJU CET 2025 under any circumstances. If a candidate misses the scheduled exam date or fails to appear, they lose their chance to be considered for admission through AJU CET. It's important to appear on the date mentioned on the admit card.
AJU CET 2026 Highlights

value: AJU CET - Arka Jaun University Common Entrance Test
To shortlist candidates for UG & PG programmes for Engineering, Pharmacy, Law, Commerce, etc.
Online computer‑based test, single shift (varies by programme)
MCQ format (~100 Qs); B.Tech: Physics, Maths, CS, English; Diploma: English, Maths, Science, GA
Questions are generally based on the respective programme-level curriculum, such as passing an exam – Class 10 level for polytechnic, 10+2 level for UG, etc.
Example for B.Tech: 10+2 with PCM, ≥ 45% (40% for reserved)
15+ courses including B.Tech, B.Pharma, BBA‑LLB, BCA, BA (Hons), etc.
AJU‑CET score + counselling; some programmes accept JEE Main, CUET, CLAT, NEET, GPAT, MAT/XAT for MBA, etc.

Engineering & IT

AJU CET 2026 Eligibility Criteria
The eligibility criteria of various programs at Arka Jain University are mentioned below:

value: MCA (AI & DL ) in association with IBM

BCA / B.Sc (IT) / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science Engineering, or an equivalent degree. OR Passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A./B.Tech./B. Voc. with Mathematics at the 10+2 or graduation level (with additional bridge courses as required by the relevant university). At least 50% (45% for candidates from the reserved category) in the qualifying examination. Should have a valid score card for the university's AJU-Combined Entrance Test (AJUCET) or Common University Entrance Test (CUET) administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA).

Passed the 10+2 test in Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Computer Science, Electronics, Information Technology, Biology, Informatics Practices, Biotechnology, Technical Vocational Subjects, Agriculture, Engineering Graphics, Business Studies, and Entrepreneurship. Mechanical Engineering requires the following subjects at the 10+2 level: Physics, Chemistry, and Math. Physics and Math are mandatory subjects at the 10+2 level for Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Physics and Math are mandatory subjects at the 10+2 level for Computer Science and Engineering.

blocks.value: AJU CET 2026 Exam Pattern
Exam pattern details:
Each question carries one mark. There is no minus marking. The questions are from Computer Science, Physics, English and Maths. The test is conducted in English.
No, there is no negative marking in AJU CET, allowing candidates to attempt all questions without fear of losing marks.
The AJU CET will be conducted in online mode as a Computer-Based Test (CBT). The exam will be conducted in single shift.

The AJU CET exam duration is 120 minutes (2 hours) for all courses, except for B.Pharm (Lateral Entry), which is 60 minutes. Candidates must report at least 30 minutes before the scheduled time. Late entry is not permitted. No candidate can leave the exam hall before completion of the test.
There will be 100 multiple-choice questions based on Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, and English. The difficulty level will be Class 11/12 level.
AJU CET 2026 Admit Card

value: The AJU CET 2025 Admit Card will be released online on official website of Arka Jain University before the exam date. Candidates who successfully submitted their application form will be issued the admit card to appear in the exam. The exam body also sends admit card of AJU CET 2025 to candidates at their registered email address.

The admit card will cosist of candidate’s name, roll number, exam date and time, test centre address, and important exam day instructions. They are advised to check all details carefully and contact the university authorities in case of discrepancies.
They have to carry the admit card to exam centre along with a valid photo ID proof, such as an aadhar card, voter ID, or driving license, etc.
Candidates failing to carry their admit card to the exam centre will not be permitted to enter the exam hall.

blocks.value: AJU CET 2026 Result

As the AJU CET exam is conducted in a phase-wise manner and the result will also be declared in a phase-wise manner. The exam body will declare the same on its official website, and c andidates will have to log in using their credentials to view and download their scorecard. The AJU CET result will be displayed section-wise marks, total score, and qualifying status. Based on the candidate's performance in the AJU CET, candidates who are shortlisted will be invited for further admission procedures, including counselling. AJU CET does not dispatch physical copies of results; hence, students must visit the official website regularly for any updates, as the result is a document to determine a candidate's eligibility for various UG and PG courses offered under the AJU CET admission pathway.
AJU CET Counselling 2026

The counselling starts after results are declared. Students can check qualification status from official URL. They will also be informed about counselling dates, venue (if offline), and required documents via registered email. AJU CET counselling might be held across multiple rounds depending on seat availability and course preferences. During counselling process, students must verify all documents and pay admission fee. Failing to attend in counselling or providing valid documentation, may result in disqualification. Students are advised to keep all documents ready and follow instructions provided by Arka Jain University carefully while attending counselling.
AJU CET 2026 BTech Scholarship Details
Arka Jain University Scholarship
Candidates applying for AJU CET can avail 100% scholarship. AJU offers scholarships up to INR 5 crore. Scholarship details are given below:
AJU CET Phase 1
The duration of phase 1 is November 1, 2024 - April 30, 2025. Eligible candidates can avail of a fee waiver for first-year academic fees (One-time).
AJU CET Phase 2
The duration of phase 2 is May 1, 2025, to the end of the academic session. Eligible candidates can avail of a fee waiver in the first-year academic fee (One-time).

Candidates are requested to fill out the application form in the AJU CET phase 1 to confirm their seat at Arka Jain University. For more information, visit the official website - arkajainuniversity.ac.in.

What is GCET?

The Goa Common Entrance Test (Goa CET) exam was held at state level. DTE Goa conducted the exam for admission to professional degree courses in Engineering offered at various colleges in Goa. However, note that the exam is no longer held. All UG Engineering admissions in the state is based on JEE Main 2026 exam score. Candidates have to apply with their JEE Main exam scores and a merit list will be drawn based on the JEE Main ranks. In the counselling process, candidates have to fill their choice of courses and colleges in order of preference at the venue. Based on the preference of the candidates, their JEE Main ranks, and other factors, seats will be allotted to the candidates.

For admissions, the authorities consider the JEE Main 2025 ranks. Candidates have been allotted seats based on their candidate's rank, preferences and seat availability. If the candidates fail to confirm their admission before the final date, then their allotment will be cancelled.

GCET/Goa BE Admission 2025 Application Form

GCET/Goa BE admission 2025 application form was released offline. All eligible candidates with a valid JEE Main 2025 score/rank had to fill out and submit the Goa BE 2025 application form to participate in the counselling and admission process. After the final date, no applications were accepted by the authorities. Candidates had to pay the application fee of INR 2000 online, i.e., through net banking/credit card/debit card. If the candidates were unable to fill out the application form before the final date, then they were not considered for the GCET/Goa BE 2025 admission process.
GCET/Goa BE Admission 2025 Eligibility Criteria
Candidates applying for admission to the courses offered in the state through GCET/Goa BE admission will have to comply with the following eligibility norms.
Nationality:

value: Non-resident Indians holding Indian passports may also apply for seats reserved under the NRI category.
Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) /Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) cardholders are also considered eligible for admission to seats under the NRI Category.
Foreign Nationals must apply to Govt. of India.

blocks.value: Valid score in JEE Main 2025

value: Candidates must have appeared and obtained a valid score in the JEE Main conducted for the year of admission. JEE Main score of the previous year/s is not considered valid.
For Architecture, the candidate must have appeared and obtained a valid score at NATA conducted by the Council of Architecture.

blocks.value: Qualifying Examination & Minimum Marks:

value: Candidates should have cleared the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination of the Goa Board.
Or an examination conducted by the Central Board of Secondary Education, New Delhi, or any other examination equivalent to the H.S.S.C. examination of Goa Board.
They must also have acquired the minimum percentage of marks in the specific subjects.

blocks.value: First Year B.E.:

value: Candidates should have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Std.XIIth) examination of the Goa Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education or its equivalent examination with English, Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects with one of the following subjects Chemistry/Bio-Technology/Computer Science /Biology, and secured not less than 45% marks in the aggregate of subjects of Physics & Mathematics with one of the following subjects Chemistry/Bio-Technology/Computer Science/Biology. (40% for the applicants belonging to SC, ST and OBC only).

Candidates should have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Std.XIIth) examination of the Goa Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education or its equivalent examination with Mathematics as one of the subjects and secured at least 50% marks in aggregate (45% aggregate marks for applicants belonging to SC/ST/OBC).

blocks.value: OR

value: 10+3 Diploma (any stream) recognised by Central/State Governments with 50% aggregate marks.

blocks.value: OR

value: International Baccalaureate Diploma, after 10 years of schooling, with not less than 50% marks in aggregate and with Mathematics as a compulsory subject of examination.

blocks.value: Kashmiri Migrants only in Engineering Courses:

value: The candidate should have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Std.XIIth) examination or its equivalent examination with English, Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects with one of the following subjects Chemistry/Bio-Technology/Computer Science/Biology and secured not less than 45% marks in the subjects of Physics & Mathematics with one of the following subjects Chemistry/Bio-Technology/Computer Science/Biology.

blocks.value: Diploma/BSc Degree holder:

value: Candidates who have passed a Diploma in Engineering /B.Sc. Degree with Mathematics as a subject at Std XIIth, with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC), were eligible for admission to First Year of Engineering Degree Courses, subject to vacancies in First Year after vacancies at Lateral Entry into Direct Second Year are exhausted.
The merit list of such candidates is prepared based on aggregate marks scored at the qualifying exam.

GCET admit card will be released by the authorities. Registered candidates do not need any credentials to access and download the admit card of GCET. After the GCET application form is filled, submitted and the fee is paid, candidates will receive the admit card in their registered email ID.

At the examination centre,  candidates will have to bring their GCET admit card. Along with admit card, candidates will also have to present one identity proof. Any of the identity proofs are valid to be presented at the examination centre - Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/PAN Card/Passport/Driver's License/School ID.

The authorities will not accept any requests to change the allotted exam centre after the GCET admit card. While filling out the application form, the candidates are advised to be careful while filling out their exam centre preferences. The authorities will allot the GCET exam centres as per the preferences and availability of the centre. No changes can be made after the centres have been allotted.

Not applicable since GCET will not be held and admissions will be done based on JEE Main scores

GCET syllabus will be prepared and released by the authorities of the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) Goa online at dte.goa.gov.in. No other mode will be used to declare the official GCET syllabus. The subjects, units and topics to be studied for the entrance examination will be released through the GCET syllabus. While preparing for the examination, the candidates are advised to check the official syllabus.

For GCET Chemistry, candidates should study entire syllabus and focus on important topics. These important topics will help candidates score well in the exam. Candidates can find important topics after checking previous year's papers.

For GCET, students should prepare entire syllabus. Since question paper will be prepared based on topics from GCET syllabus, it will help them to score well in exam. However, students can check some important topics and focus on them.
GCET 2025 Exam Pattern
Not applicable since GCET will not be held and admissions will be done based on JEE Main scores

The authorities will release the GCET exam pattern 2025 online. Information regarding how the entrance examination will be conducted will be available through the GCET 2025 exam pattern . Details such as exam mode, duration, type of questions, sections, marking scheme and more will be made available. GCET 2025 will be held as a pen-and-paper-based test.
According to GCET exam pattern, total duration of entrance examination is 6 hours. GCET has three papers, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. For each paper, 2 hours will be given.

According to GCET pattern, the exam will have 225 objective questions. Paper is divided into three sections, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Each section will have 75 questions. For every question, correct option has to be selected.

The official marking scheme of GCET will be prepared and released by the authorities. For every correct response, the candidates will be allotted one mark. The authorities will not deduct any marks for incorrect answers. Unattempted questions will also not be marked negatively. Since there is no negative marking, the candidates are advised to attempt all questions in GCET to raise their chances of scoring well in the entrance examination.

What is GCET?

The Goa Common Entrance Test (Goa CET) exam was held at state level. DTE Goa conducted the exam for admission to professional degree courses in Engineering offered at various colleges in Goa. However, note that the exam is no longer held. All UG Engineering admissions in the state is based on JEE Main 2026 exam score. Candidates have to apply with their JEE Main exam scores and a merit list will be drawn based on the JEE Main ranks. In the counselling process, candidates have to fill their choice of courses and colleges in order of preference at the venue. Based on the preference of the candidates, their JEE Main ranks, and other factors, seats will be allotted to the candidates.

faqs.answer: For GCET, students should prepare entire syllabus. Since question paper will be prepared based on topics from GCET syllabus, it will help them to score well in exam. However, students can check some important topics and focus on them.

faqs.question: What is the duration of GCET?
faqs.answer: According to GCET exam pattern, total duration of entrance examination is 6 hours. GCET has three papers, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. For each paper, 2 hours will be given.

faqs.question: What is the division of questions in the GCET paper?
faqs.answer: According to GCET pattern, the exam will have 225 objective questions. Paper is divided into three sections, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Each section will have 75 questions. For every question, correct option has to be selected.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of GCET?
faqs.answer: The official marking scheme of GCET will be prepared and released by the authorities. For every correct response, the candidates will be allotted one mark. The authorities will not deduct any marks for incorrect answers. Unattempted questions will also not be marked negatively. Since there is no negative marking, the candidates are advised to attempt all questions in GCET to raise their chances of scoring well in the entrance examination.

faqs.question: Is exam pattern important for GCET preparation?
faqs.answer: For GCET preparation, candidates should know exam pattern. Through exam pattern, candidates can check details on how examination will be held. Some important details are exam duration, number of questions, marking information and more.

faqs.question: Are mock tests essential for GCET preparation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates are advised to attempt mock tests regularly to be well prepared for GCET. By attempting mock tests, the candidates will be able to understand how the entrance examination will be held. Mock tests will also help the candidates to know the current preparation progress and their commonly made mistakes. By identifying their commonly made mistakes, the candidates will be able to correct it so that the same is not made during the exam. Mock tests also help the candidates boost their time management skills.

faqs.question: What are the best books for GCET Physics section?
faqs.answer: For GCET Physics section, students can prepare by studying from books by popular authors like HC Verma and DC Pandey. Through these books, students can prepare well for exam.

faqs.question: What are the credentials required to check the GCET answer key?
faqs.answer: Candidates will be able to check GCET answer key online. They will not need log in credentials to download answer key. To check and download GCET answer key, candidates will have to select their course paper at official website.

faqs.question: Can I calculate my probable scores using GCET answer key?
faqs.answer: Candidates can calculate their probable secured scores using GCET answer key. Candidates will have to download answer key and compare it to their individual responses. Official marking scheme as per GCET exam pattern has to be followed.

faqs.question: When will GCET final answer key be available?
faqs.answer: The Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Goa will not release the final answer key of GCET online. Since no objections against the provisional GCET answer key will be accepted by the authorities, they will not prepare the final key. The decision of the authorities on the provisional answer key will remain absolute. The official GCET result will be prepared based on the answer key. In case of any problems, the candidates are advised to contact the authorities.

faqs.question: What is the KREE Application Form Fee?

faqs.question: How many questions are asked from each section in KREE?

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for KREE?

What is KREE?

K.R. Mangalam University conducts KREE (KR Entrance Exam), for admissions into undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Eligible candidates must complete Application Form, appear for KREE Entrance Examination, and attend Faculty-Led Interview as part of admission.
KREE exam is for 30 minutes. Candidates must improve time management skills to ensure they complete entrance examination within given time. Once examination ends, candidates must submit papers.
The following are the courses for which admission is based on KREE score
BTech. Computer Science and Engineering (4 Years)
BTech Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML) with academic support of Samatrix and IBM (4 Years)
BTech Computer Science and Engineering (Full Stack Development) with academic support of Xebia (4 Years)
BTech Computer Science & Engineering (UX/UI) with academic support of ImaginXP (4 Years)
BTech Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) with academic support of EC-Council and IBM (4 Years)
BTech Mechanical Engineering (Automotive Designs & Electric Vehicle) with academic support of Siemens (4 Years)

KREE is the gateway for getting admission to preferred undergraduate and postgraduate programmes offered by the University. The admission procedure includes appearing for entrance test and attending faculty-led entrance test.

blocks.value: GIETEE 2026: The exam body, GIET University, Gunupur, is accepting the GIETEE 2026 application form . To fill the the application form of GIETEE students must visit the official website - apply-gietee.gietu.in . Candidates interested in applying for admission into B. Tech courses at GIET University require completing the registration process by filling in the details, such as their name, email address, phone number, upload scanned documents successfully . The direct link to fill out the GIETEE 2026 application form is provided on this page. Candidates can also get the application form of GIETEE from the university admission office at Gunupur or its regional/zonal offices.

The exam body will issue the admit card of GIETEE 2026 to all the candidates who successfully submit the application form. As per the past year GIETEE 2026 exam dates , the entrance test is expected to be conducted tentatively in June 2026. T o prepare for the entrance exam students are advised to refer to the GIETEE 2026 syllabus this will help them know the subjects, topics and sub-topics on which the question paper will be based. Students must also check the GIETEE 2026 exam pattern to know the marking scheme, time duration of the exam. Check all the details related to the GIETEE 2026 exam here.
What is GIETEE ?

The exam body, GIET University, Gunupur, conducts the GIET Entrance Examination or GIETEE annually. The exam is conducted every year in May in various cities of the country. The entrance test is conducted to shortlist candidates for admission into B.Tech. Programmes offered by the university at its campus. Students meeting the minimum eligibility criteria can apply to take admission into B.Tech courses. The university provided B.Tech programs in 11 specialisations.

The selection of candidates will be based on marks secured in the GIETEE 2026 examination. The university will release a merit list of candidates based on marks in GIETEE 2026, and seats will be allotted based on merit positions. Candidates must note that admission in the institute for 50% seats is through JEE Main rank, while 50% seats are filled through OJEE/GIETEE.

The process of admission for 50% of seats through JEE Main is carried out by OJEE counselling. The process of admission in the remaining 50% OJEE/GIETEE seats is done through university counselling. Candidates can check here the complete details about the GIETEE 2026 application and admission process, exam dates, syllabus, exam pattern, and other important information about the GIET Entrance Examination.

Computed-Based Test (CBT) Pen and paper-based test (PBT)
