blocks.value: GIETEE 2026 Application Form

The application form for GIETEE 2026 will be made available online soon. Candidates can fill out the application form online using the link on this page or from the university website. The application form can also be downloaded from the university website as a PDF or purchased from the university admission offices. The offline application form, purchased or downloaded from the website, has to be filled out and submitted by post to GIET University before the last date, along with all the required documents. Candidates can check here the complete step-by-step process to fill the GIETEE application form 2026.
⇒ Fill GIETEE Application Form 2026
How to Fill the GIETEE Application Form Online

value: Open the official website of GIET University
Click on the "Apply for GIETEE 2026" link
Fill in all the required details and click on the submit button to complete the registration

In the next step, candidates will be required to fill the detailed application form with information about educational qualification, exam centre choice, address, preference of course, and various other details
After filling the application form, candidates have to upload a scanned image of their passport-size colour photo
Pay the application fees using a credit/debit card or internet banking

blocks.value: The application form will be automatically submitted after the successful payment of the application fees. Candidates need to download and take a printout of their filled application form.
How to Fill the GIETEE Application Form Offline

value: Download the GIETEE 2026 application form from the website or purchase it from the university admission office
Fill the complete application form with a Blue/Black ballpoint pen
Paste the passport-size colour photograph and sign at the prescribed place
Check whether all the details are filled with correct information

blocks.value: After filling the application form, send it through the post to reach the university admission office at the address before the last date. Candidates need to enclose the DD of INR 1000 in favour of GIET University Chennai, payable at Gunupur from any nationalised bank. Also, candidates need to retain a xerox copy of their filled application form before sending it through the post.
GITEE 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates are advised to check the eligibility criteria of GIET University, which every candidate has to fulfill to get admission to the institute. The complete details of the GIETEE eligibility criteria can be checked below. Candidates not fulfilling the conditions of eligibility will not be considered for admission.
Qualifying Examination

value: Candidates must have studied Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics in class 12 or equivalent standard before admission to the B.Tech. Degree Programmes
For B.Tech. in Biotechnology, candidates must have studied Physics, Chemistry, and Biology in class 12 or equivalent
Candidates must have secured an aggregate of 50% in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics /Biology in the qualifying examination (10+2 or equivalent) appearing for the GIETEE-2026.

What is GIETEE ?

The process of admission for 50% of seats through JEE Main is carried out by OJEE counselling. The process of admission in the remaining 50% OJEE/GIETEE seats is done through university counselling. counselling.title: GIETEE 2026 Counselling & Seat Allotment: Registration Dates, Procedure

blocks.value: GIETEE Counselling 2026: The counselling process for admission to the B.Tech course through GIETEE/OJEE will be conducted by the university. The schedule for GIETEE 2026 counselling will be notified on the official website and also on this page after the result declaration.  A Common selection and Admission procedure will be followed through single-window counselling for all the B.Tech programmes.

The GIETEE 2026 counselling for allocation of branches to the short-listed candidates is based on their All India Rank (AIR) in GIETEE-2026. A candidate can obtain this information on the official website or by calling the university’s office, a day after the declaration of the results of GIETEE-2026. After the counselling for a particular day is over, the number of seats (branch-wise) available for allotment for the next day of counselling will be published on the website. If the mark statement of the qualifying exam has not been received before the date of counselling, the candidate would have to furnish an undertaking stating that if he/she fails to qualify as per the norms, it would lead him/her to forego his/her seat. Candidates will not be permitted to attend counselling more than once under any circumstances. Similarly, no change of branch will be entertained.
Documents required for GIETEE 2026 Counselling

The intimation regarding counselling dates will also be displayed on the GIET University website. SMS will also be sent to the qualified candidates after the declaration of the results. Candidates who have been shortlisted for counselling should also attend the same, in person.

Details of the various branches offered under the BTech programme in the current year, the total number of seats allocated for each branch at the time of counselling, and the number of seats still available will be displayed at the counselling centre to enable the candidates to make their choice. Based on availability, the candidate will be allotted the branch.

To take care of possible absentees, the number of qualified candidates is kept more than the number of seats available in GIET UNIVERSITY. The fact that a candidate has qualified in the GIETEE-2026 and has been called for counselling does not guarantee admission to him/her. This depends upon the candidate's All India Rank (AIR) in the entrance examination and the availability of seats.

Candidates should check the GIET UNIVERSITY website: www.giet.edu for information about counselling. No change of date/time of counselling is permissible. If a candidate does not personally appear before the Admission Committee for counselling on the date specified, his/her seat shall be offered to the next candidate in the order of merit.

However, due to unforeseen reasons, if a candidate is unable to attend the counselling on the specified date and time, he/she can attend on a subsequent date/time, after duly informing the office, regarding this. But the candidate can only opt for the branch available then and cannot claim any other branch as per his/her original turn/seniority.

The candidates should produce the following documents in original along with two sets of photocopies while reporting for counselling. Candidates will not be allowed to participate in the counselling process without these documents.

value: Class X Board Certificate as proof of date of birth

What is GIETEE ?

The exam body, GIET University, Gunupur, conducts the GIET Entrance Examination or GIETEE annually. The exam is conducted every year in May in various cities of the country. The entrance test is conducted to shortlist candidates for admission into B.Tech. Programmes offered by the university at its campus. Students meeting the minimum eligibility criteria can apply to take admission into B.Tech courses. The university provided B.Tech programs in 11 specialisations.

The selection of candidates will be based on marks secured in the GIETEE 2026 examination. The university will release a merit list of candidates based on marks in GIETEE 2026, and seats will be allotted based on merit positions. Candidates must note that admission in the institute for 50% seats is through JEE Main rank, while 50% seats are filled through OJEE/GIETEE.

The process of admission for 50% of seats through JEE Main is carried out by OJEE counselling. The process of admission in the remaining 50% OJEE/GIETEE seats is done through university counselling. What is ISI Admission Test?

The Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) conducts the Indian Statistical Institute Admission Test which is the ISI Admission Test, which offers students admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses which are offered at the ISI. Admission to the academic programmes offered at the ISI Kolkata is strictly based on the merits obtained by the candidates, which are evaluated on their performance in ISI admission tests and interviews. The candidate's past academic records may also be taken into account for performance evaluation.
To do ISI admission test 2026 preparation you need to do these steps:
Understand syllabus & pattern
Make a schedule and plan.
Make your foundation study the core subjects.
Do proper time management.
Most important thing is to take 6 - 7 hours of sleep before exam.
The major objectives of the Institute, as stated in its Memorandum of Association, are:

(i) to promote the study and dissemination of knowledge of Statistics, to develop statistical theory and methods, and their use in research and practical applications generally, with special reference to problems of planning for national development and social welfare;
(ii) to undertake research in various elds of natural and social sciences with a view to the mutual development of Statistics and these sciences;

(iii) to provide for, and undertake, the collection of information, investigations, projects, and operational research for purposes of planning and the improvement of efficiency of management and production.

Over the last several years, the Institute has been very actively pursuing an institution-level collaboration that has led to Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) with numerous universities/academic institutions as well as industrial organisations. These MOUs range from collaborative research to research grants for students/faculty as well as student/faculty exchange programmes. ISI Admission Test 2026 Preparation

ISI Admission Test 2026 Preparation tips help the candidates strategically prepare for the examination to get the extra edge in the scorecard. Test takers must start their ISI Admission Test preparation 2025 by deeply analysing the exam pattern, syllabus and previous year question papers. ISI admission Test syllabus will help the candidates in shortlisting the topics that need to be focused on for preparation and candidates must prepare their timetable accordingly.
For doing ISI admission test preparation, students need to follow these prep tips:
Understand the ISI Admission Test Exam Pattern & Marking Scheme

One should know ISI Admission Test exam pattern. The duration of the entrance exam, what language the exam will be in, and whether it will be in offline mode (pen and paper test) or in online mode (computer-based test). One should know the basics about the entrance exam before the main day so that there is no confusion at the last minute. You should also go through the instructions mentioned on the prospectus to know what the entrance exam will demand and what the guidelines will be.

Other than exam pattern, one should also know the marking scheme of the ISI Admission Test. How many questions will be asked, how many marks will be awarded per question, how many marks per section, will there be negative marking and so on. On knowing the marking scheme and the pattern of the paper, one knows what to expect in the ISI Admission Test and hence, one save time rather than wasting it. Once all the details of the ISI Admission Test are known, you are set to go.
Get the ISI Admission Test Syllabus

One should only prescribe the syllabus according to the course applied for. For undergraduate courses, the best way is to stick to what one has learnt in Class 11 and Class 12. For Mathematics and Statistics, one should know the type of questions that will be asked, the topics which are in the curriculum, such as Probability, Analysis, Programming and Data Structure and much more. For the postgraduate course, one should stick to the lessons learnt in the undergraduate course and get prep books as well to help prepare better. There will be no questions from outside the syllabus, the institute informs. Stick to the syllabus and try to finish the ISI Admission Test syllabus as fast as possible to save time to revise.
Purchase Prep Books

To help prepare better, one should purchase preparation books to understand the ISI Admission Test syllabus much better. Aspirants should get the prep books according to the course applied for and study the topics accordingly. It is important for one to buy prep books that are recognised and often purchased by others. The best way to know which prep books to get is by seeking advice from college professors or teachers or even coaching centres. Aspirants should buy books that have sample papers you can solve to hone their skills.
Solve Sample Papers and Question Papers

The best way to prepare for the ISI Admission Test is by getting a hold of ISI Admission Test sample papers and previous years ISI Admission Test question papers. Aspirants will understand the marking scheme better, know the type of questions which are asked, which part of the syllabus do the questions more focus on and much more. Also, solve the question paper according to the set duration. The faster you finish, the more time you will have to recheck what you have done.
Revise

After completing your schedule for the day, take out time to revise what you have learnt. Go through the calculations again, understand what you have studied, read through what you have learnt. By revising, one understands the topics better than what they have studied. Also, do not leave revision to the last date or before the entrance exam, it will only make you more anxious and panicked. Revise while you are studying.

blocks.value: What is CEE AMPAI?

Conducted by the Association of Minority Professional Academic Institutes (AMPAI), Common Entrance Examination AMPAI-WB (CEE AMPAI WB) is an entrance exam for admissions to BTech and BPharm degree courses offered by institutes listed below, via minority quota. Preference would be given to Sikh minority students; however, remaining seats will be filled by students from other religion/caste/category across India, subject to fulfilling the required eligibility criteria.
The last date to apply for CEE AMPAI was August 2026.
CEE AMPAI stands for Common Entrance Examination Association of Minority Professional Academic Institutes.

Registration for CEE AMPAI 2026 was necessary to participate in the admission process.
CEE AMPAI 2026 Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible to appear for CEE AMPAI 2026, the students should ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria mentioned below:

value: The students must be a minimum of 17 years of age on December 31. There is no upper age limit for the exam. As proof, students can produce the date of birth recorded in the Class X examination under any School/Secondary Education Board Certificate/Admit Card.

blocks.value: For admissions to BTech programmes:

value: Students must have passed the 10+2 Examination from a recognised Council/Board.

They should have secured individual pass Physics, Mathematics marks along with any one of Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Biology/ Computer Science/ Computer Application as compulsory subjects with individual pass marks (in both theory & practical wherever applicable) in regular mode.
They should have secured a minimum of 45% marks in the subjects mentioned above taken together.
They should also have passed in their English subject in  10+2 with a minimum of 30% marks.

blocks.value: Note : Students appearing in their 10+2 exam in 2026 will be eligible to take the exam. However, if they fail to pass the exam with the required minimum standard of eligibility criteria mentioned above, they would not be eligible for allotment of seats for admission.
The entrance test for CEE AMPAI 2026 will be held in an offline mode i.e. pen and paper based test.

blocks.value: What is CEE AMPAI?

Conducted by the Association of Minority Professional Academic Institutes (AMPAI), Common Entrance Examination AMPAI-WB (CEE AMPAI WB) is an entrance exam for admissions to BTech and BPharm degree courses offered by institutes listed below, via minority quota. Preference would be given to Sikh minority students; however, remaining seats will be filled by students from other religion/caste/category across India, subject to fulfilling the required eligibility criteria.
The last date to apply for CEE AMPAI was August 2026.
CEE AMPAI stands for Common Entrance Examination Association of Minority Professional Academic Institutes.
CEE AMPAI 2026 Exam Dates & Schedule
Take a look at the table below for the complete schedule of CEE AMPAI 2026 exam

value: CEE AMPAI 2026 Application Form Availability TENTATIVE

Association of Minority Professional Academic Institutes
Category I - One mark will be given for a correct response. No negative marking. Category II - Two marks will be given for a correct response. No negative marking.

blocks.value: DFP-Banner
No negative marking for wrong/ multiple answers.
Association of Minority Professional Academic Institutes (AMPAI) conducts the CEE AMPAI WB exam for admissions undergraduate courses.
CEE AMPAI 2026 Application Form
Registration : Jul ' 26 - Aug ' 26

The authorities will release the application form of CEE AMPAI 2026 in both online and offline modes. Candidates had to fill in their personal, academic and communication details in the CEE AMPAI application form 2026. All of the details had to be valid and as per the documents possessed by the candidates. The required application fee had to be paid before the final date. Registration for CEE AMPAI 2026 was necessary to participate in the admission process.
CEE AMPAI 2026 Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible to appear for CEE AMPAI 2026, the students should ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria mentioned below:

value: The students must be a minimum of 17 years of age on December 31. There is no upper age limit for the exam. As proof, students can produce the date of birth recorded in the Class X examination under any School/Secondary Education Board Certificate/Admit Card.

blocks.value: For admissions to BTech programmes:

value: Students must have passed the 10+2 Examination from a recognised Council/Board.

They should have secured individual pass Physics, Mathematics marks along with any one of Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Biology/ Computer Science/ Computer Application as compulsory subjects with individual pass marks (in both theory & practical wherever applicable) in regular mode.
They should have secured a minimum of 45% marks in the subjects mentioned above taken together.
They should also have passed in their English subject in  10+2 with a minimum of 30% marks.

blocks.value: Note : Students appearing in their 10+2 exam in 2026 will be eligible to take the exam. However, if they fail to pass the exam with the required minimum standard of eligibility criteria mentioned above, they would not be eligible for allotment of seats for admission.
The entrance test for CEE AMPAI 2026 will be held in an offline mode i.e. pen and paper based test.
CEE AMPAI 2026 application forms was available online and offline.

The subjects, topics and units that have to be studied for entrance examination will be released through CEE AMPAI syllabus 2026 . To be well prepared for exam, the candidates are advised to check syllabus beforehand. The list of topics to be studied will allow candidates to know how they can prepare to score well in the entrance exam.
CEE AMPAI 2026 Exam Pattern

The authorities will release the CEE AMPAI exam pattern 2026 online. The candidates are advised to check the exam pattern of CEE AMPAI 2026 to understand how the entrance examination will be conducted. Details regarding the exam mode, duration, type of questions, marking scheme and more will be released through the exam pattern.

value: Candidates must carry one photo ID proof to the exam center
Do not staple or pin the photograph

Unfair practices are not allowed inside the exam hall.

Enter the exam hall only with the admit card and blue/black ball point pen
Submit the OMR Answer Sheet to the Invigilator after completion of each session of the Examination.

blocks.value: AISECT University Exam Eligibility Criteria
Candidates need to fulfill the below-mentioned AJEE 2026 eligibility criteria to be eligible to take AISECT University Entrance Exam for Engineering course admissions:
Bachelor of Engineering (BE)

Candidates are eligible to apply for AJEE 2026 Bachelor of Engineering course if they have cleared their Class 12 with PCM and have secured a minimum of 45% marks. For candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC category, the minimum percentage that they should secure in their Class 12 is 40%.
Masters of Engineering (ME)
Bachelor’s degree with at least 50% marks (40% in case of SC/ST).
Engineering Diploma Programme
Candidates meet AJEE 2026 eligibility criteria for engineering diploma programmes if they have cleared their 10 th standard (SSC with minimum 35% marks).

Note: Aspirants are informed that if they are appearing for their qualifying examination in the same year as when they want to appear for the AISECT University Entrance Exam then they also meet AJEE 2026 eligibility criteria.
List of qualifying examinations that are accepted for AISECT University admissions 2026 is as mentioned below:

value: The Class 12 level exam in 10+2 pattern of any recognised Central/State Board Secondary Examination, such as CBSE, New Delhi and Council for Indian School Certificate Examination, New Delhi. For General category candidates, the qualifying marks are at least 45% and for SC/ST/OBC candidates the qualifying marks if 40% minimum.
Intermediate or two-year pre-university exam conducted by a recognised Board/University.
Final examination of the two-year course of the Joint Services Wing of the National Defense Academy.
Any Public School/Board/University Examination in India or in foreign countries recognised by the Association of Indian Universities as equivalent to 10+2  system.
HSC Vocational Examination. A passing grade in the Senior Secondary School Examination conducted by the National Open School with a minimum of five subjects.

blocks.value: The AJEE eligibility criteria for Bachelor of Engineering programme is passing class 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics and having obtained a minimum score of 45%. In the case of SC/ST/OBC category candidates it is 40%.

Applicants fulfil the AJEE eligibility requirements for engineering Diploma programmes if they have passed their 10th standard (SSC) with a minimum of 35% marks. Prospective candidates should be aware that even if they are taking their qualifying examination in the same year as they plan to appear for the AISECT University Entrance Exam, they still satisfy the eligibility criteria for AJEE.

AISECT University Entrance Exam (AJEE) is a national-level common entrance exam that candidates need to give to secure admission in programmes offered at different colleges of AISECT University . Also, based on an aspirant's performance in AJEE, he/she can secure admission to Rabindranath Tagore University, Bhopal; Dr CV Raman University Bilaspur, CG ; AISECT University, Hazaribagh; Dr CV Raman University, Vaishali; Dr CV Raman University, Khandwa. The courses in which candidates can secure admission based on their performance in AJEE 2026 are as mentioned below:

Candidates can apply for AJEE on the AISECT University website. Applicants have to complete registration, form-filling, document upload and fee payment. Candidates must check the eligibility criteria before applying online.
The AJEE exam duration is 2 hours. The question paper will comprise of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) for a total of 100 marks.
The AJEE exam is conducted multiple times a year. The exact dates will be updated on the AISECT University website. Students must check the website for all the latest updates.

blocks.value: AISECT University Exam Eligibility Criteria
Candidates need to fulfill the below-mentioned AJEE 2026 eligibility criteria to be eligible to take AISECT University Entrance Exam for Engineering course admissions:
Bachelor of Engineering (BE)

Candidates are eligible to apply for AJEE 2026 Bachelor of Engineering course if they have cleared their Class 12 with PCM and have secured a minimum of 45% marks. For candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC category, the minimum percentage that they should secure in their Class 12 is 40%.
Masters of Engineering (ME)
Bachelor’s degree with at least 50% marks (40% in case of SC/ST).
Engineering Diploma Programme
Candidates meet AJEE 2026 eligibility criteria for engineering diploma programmes if they have cleared their 10 th standard (SSC with minimum 35% marks).

Note: Aspirants are informed that if they are appearing for their qualifying examination in the same year as when they want to appear for the AISECT University Entrance Exam then they also meet AJEE 2026 eligibility criteria.
List of qualifying examinations that are accepted for AISECT University admissions 2026 is as mentioned below:

value: The Class 12 level exam in 10+2 pattern of any recognised Central/State Board Secondary Examination, such as CBSE, New Delhi and Council for Indian School Certificate Examination, New Delhi. For General category candidates, the qualifying marks are at least 45% and for SC/ST/OBC candidates the qualifying marks if 40% minimum.
Intermediate or two-year pre-university exam conducted by a recognised Board/University.
Final examination of the two-year course of the Joint Services Wing of the National Defense Academy.
Any Public School/Board/University Examination in India or in foreign countries recognised by the Association of Indian Universities as equivalent to 10+2  system.
HSC Vocational Examination. A passing grade in the Senior Secondary School Examination conducted by the National Open School with a minimum of five subjects.

blocks.value: The AJEE eligibility criteria for Bachelor of Engineering programme is passing class 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics and having obtained a minimum score of 45%. In the case of SC/ST/OBC category candidates it is 40%.

Applicants fulfil the AJEE eligibility requirements for engineering Diploma programmes if they have passed their 10th standard (SSC) with a minimum of 35% marks. Prospective candidates should be aware that even if they are taking their qualifying examination in the same year as they plan to appear for the AISECT University Entrance Exam, they still satisfy the eligibility criteria for AJEE.

Step 2: Get AJEE Admit Card

AISECT University Entrance Exam 2026 admit card is sent to candidates at registered email addresses. Candidates need to ensure that they provide valid email IDs only in application form otherwise they would not be able to receive hall ticket for AJEE 2026. Candidates can also download admit cards from official website of the exam.
Step 3: Give AJEE Exam

AJEE exam is of 2 hours duration, candidates need to attempt multiple-choice questions. For admission in majority of the courses offered at AISECT University, candidates are evaluated out of 100 marks.
For LLM course admission, candidates need to appear for an interview round after they qualify AJEE 2026.
Step 4: Check AJEE Result

AJEE 2026 result is declared on official website of AISECT University. AJEE merit list is prepared at the All India level based on an aspirant’s performance in the entrance exam conducted for AISECT University admissions.
Step 5: Appear for AJEE Counselling
Candidates need to appear in person for the counselling round for AISECT University admissions. At the time of counselling, verification of documents is done.

blocks.value: Courses Offered through OUAT Entrance Exam

For UG course admission, OUAT entrance exam test paper would be of 200 marks. The medium of instruction in the exam is English and duration is two hours. OUAT entrance exam for admission in PG and PhD courses consists of objective type as well as short answer type questions. The entrance test for PG and doctoral course admissions is of two hours duration. Courses offered at OUAT are as mentioned below:

Aspirants need to note that admission in all PG programmes is offered through OUAT entrance exam except for MSc Microbiology, MSc Biotechnology and MSc Computer Science. Admission in these programmes is conducted on the basis of career marks. Know the list of colleges that accept OUAT exam scores for admission .
OUAT Entrance Exam 2020 Admission Process
Aspirants need to follow the below mentioned steps as part of OUAT admission process
Step 1: Fill OUAT Entrance Exam Application Form

Aspirants need to fill OUAT entrance exam 2020 application form on the official website of Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology. Candidates can pay OUAT entrance exam application fee for UG course admissions by means of Bank Draft/Bankers Cheque that is drawn in favour of “Comptroller, OUAT, Bhubaneswar” and is payable at SBI OUAT Campus Branch, Bhubaneswar. The application fee can also be paid by means of State Bank Collect facility available on State Bank of India’s web page. Elaborating on the same, the official website of OUAT states: “On successful payment of application fee, he/she has to print a copy of the e-Receipt and enclose the same with the application as proof of payment. The e-Receipt contains a Reference Number starting with “DU” which the candidate may quote for all future correspondences in this regard with the University”.
Step 2: Get OUAT Exam Admit Card

Aspirants applying for UG course admissions will be sent their OUAT entrance exam 2020 admit card by speed post. The admit card for OUAT entrance exam 2020 admit card for admission in all courses contains the candidate’s name, course for which they applied, centre allotted, date and time of entrance exam, roll number, photograph and signature.
Step 3: Give OUAT Entrance Exam

In order to be eligible for admission in UG programmes offered at OUAT, candidates need to give the entrance exam which is of two hours duration. However, aspirants seeking admission in BSc (Forestry) Course should qualify Physical Endurance Test to be conducted one day before their respective day of the counselling of each category, failing which their candidature for admission into BSc (Forestry) course will not be considered”, informs the official website. OUAT entrance exam 2020 for MSc and PhD course admissions is of two hours and maximum score an aspirant can have in it is 100 marks. Candidates need to appear for OUAT entrance exam as per the date, time and venue mentioned on their admit card. Candidates who are seeking admission in PhD programmes at OUAT also need to appear for viva-voce admission round.
Step 4: Check OUAT Result

Aspirants need to visit the official website to view OUAT entrance exam 2020 result . The result for OUAT admissions cam be viewed by filling roll number/application number/Aadhaar number, mobile number and date of birth on the official website of the exam.
Step 5: Appear for Counselling

Candidates who make it to the OUAT merit list need to appear for the counselling round as per the date and time mentioned on their OUAT intimation-cum-rank card. Candidates can download their intimation-cum-rank card of their OUAT entrance exam 2020 from the official website of the exam by providing their OUAT roll number, mobile number and date of birth.
OUAT 2020 Exam Centres
Candidates can refer to the 2019 OUAT entrance exam which was conducted in 31 cities. The centres for the 2020 OUAT entrance exam will be announced by the university.
Note: Examination centre option filled by the candidates in the application form cannot be changed at later stage under any circumstances.

faqs.question: What is the format of the OUAT exam, and what types of questions can candidates expect?

faqs.question: What is the pattern of OUAT entrance exam? What is the duration of exam?
faqs.answer: The Entrance Examination will be of 2 hours duration with 200 multiple choice questions of one mark each in English language only. There will be no negative mark for the wrong answer. The multiple-choice questions (MCQ) will cover the subjects taught at the Bachelor’s Degree level and Master’s Degree (major discipline) for the Master’s and Doctoral programmes respectively.

faqs.question: What is the duration of OUAT Examination?
faqs.answer: The duration of OUAT entrance exam for undergraduate programs is of 2 hours.

faqs.question: Does OUAT exam have negative marking?
faqs.answer: No, there is no negative marking applicable in the OUAT entrance exam. This led to an increase in the cutoff of the OUAT entrance exam. Since there is no negative marking hence applicants attempt the maximum number of questions they can or even sometimes they do wild guesses. Questions that are marked correct give the applicants extra marks even without knowing the correct way of solving them. It is advisable to the students to attempt all the questions in the exam hall.

faqs.question: Is OUAT exam based on NCERT?
faqs.answer: The OUAT exam questions mainly come from the NCERT. The OUAT Exam syllabus includes subjects like Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology courses from Class 11 and Class 12 syllabi.

faqs.question: Are there any specific syllabus topics that candidates should prepare for the OUAT Exam?
faqs.answer: 1. Physics: Mechanics Heat and Thermodynamics Optics Electricity and Magnetism Modern Physics 2. Chemistry: General Chemistry Inorganic Chemistry Organic Chemistry Physical Chemistry 3. Biology (for programs related to agriculture and life sciences): Botany: Plant Anatomy, Morphology, Physiology, Genetics, Taxonomy, and Ecology Zoology: Animal Physiology, Classification, Anatomy, and Evolution 4. Mathematics (for programs where it is applicable): Algebra Trigonometry Calculus Coordinate Geometry 5. English Language Proficiency: Grammar Vocabulary Reading Comprehension Writing Skills 6. General Knowledge: Current Affairs Geography History Environmental Science Agriculture and Rural Development 7. Agricultural Science (for agriculture-related programs): Crop Science Soil Science Agricultural Economics Agronomy Horticulture Plant Pathology Animal Science (for veterinary Science programs)

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for the OUAT Entrance Exam?
faqs.answer: The OUAT Entrance Exam syllabus is based on Class 10 and 12 topics from Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology. The OUAT Undergraduate syllabus consists of Class 10 and 12 syllabi.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of OUAT entrance examination?
faqs.answer: A candidate who is appearing for the exam this year should know that the difficulty level in general is moderate to tough. Also, candidates need to score well in classes 10 and 12 so that when they appear for the OUAT Entrance Exam, 25 per cent of their class 10 and 12 scores will be added too.

faqs.question: Is the OUAT Admit Card released along with the Mock Test?
faqs.answer: Yes, the OUAT Entrance Exam admit card is released on the official website along with the mock test. The tentative date of releasing the OUAT Entrance Exam 2026 admit card is third week of May.

faqs.question: What is the release date for OUAT Entrance Exam 2026 Admit Card?
faqs.answer: The OUAT 2026 Admit Card is likely to be released in the fourth week of May 2026. Only the registered candidates will be able to download it. The exam will be held tentatively in the first week of June 2026.

faqs.question: Can I get the OUAT Entrance Exam Admit Card by post?
faqs.answer: No, the OUAT Entrance Exam admit card has to be downloaded from the exam website. Hence, the admit card or hall ticket can be accessed only in online mode. The exam authorities will not send the admit card by post.

faqs.question: What are the information carried on the OUAT Entrance Exam Admit Card?
faqs.answer: The following information are carried on the OUAT Entrance Exam Admit Card. Candidate Name Roll number Date of birth Candidate photograph Candidate signature Exam schedule (date and time) Exam centre address Exam instructions After downloading the admit card, candidates should check the details properly to avoid having any wrong information on it.

faqs.question: What are the exam centre guidelines for the online OUAT Entrance Exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates must know that they need to follow the guidelines and instructions on the day of the OUAT Exam as mentioned below: The exam will be conducted in a single sitting.  The candidate must appear for the entrance examination as per the scheduled time and date mentioned in his/her admit card. The candidates are to report 2 hours before the examination. Detailed instructions will be provided on the admit card. No Mobile phone headphones/any other electronic gadgets are allowed during the examination. Candidates, who are found to use unfair means shall be debarred from the examination. The candidates are to obey the instructions of the Centre Superintendent and Invigilators at the Examination Centre. The invigilators will take attendance on the attendance sheets, in which the candidates shall have to put their full signature against their corresponding roll number. The candidate, after logging in, must go through instructions for the examination displayed on the computer screen. The examination does not require using any paper, pen, pencil or external calculator. However, paper will be supplied for rough wor,k which will be collected by the invigilators. Each student will get questions and a choice of answers in a different order, selected randomly from the affixed Question Data bank. The students just need to click on the Right Choice / Correct option from the multiple choices/options given with each question. For Multiple Choice Questions, each question has four options, and the candidate must click the appropriate option.

faqs.question: Are the OUAT Entrance Exam centres located across India?
faqs.answer: The OUAT Entrance Exam centres are located in Odisha. Outside the state, there is one centre in New Delhi.

faqs.question: What is the date to access the OUAT Answer Key PDF?
faqs.answer: The OUAT 2026 Answer Key PDF will be released tentatively in the fourth week of June. Test takers can access the answer keys on the official website.

faqs.question: What is the release date for OUAT 2026 Answer Key?
faqs.answer: The OUAT 2026 Answer Key is expected to be released in the fourth week of June. In general, the exam authority releases the provisional answer key within a few weeks of conducting the exam. The last date to submit objections is within three to four days of the release date.

faqs.question: How to access OUAT 2026 Answer Key?
faqs.answer: To download the OUAT Entrance Exam Answer Keys, candidates have to go to the university and log in with their registered IDs. The objection submission window is likely to be scheduled in the fourth week of June 2026. The actual dates will be announced by officials after the exam is conducted in the first week of June.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory to challenge the OUAT answer key within the given timeline?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is mandatory to submit challenges or objections against the OUAT answer key within the said date. It is expected that the provisional answer keys and response sheets will be released in the fourth week of June. The last date to submit challenges will be within the next few days. Candidates will not be allowed to submit objections against the OUAT Entrance Exam once the window is over.

faqs.question: What is OUAT passing marks?
faqs.answer: OUAT Passing Marks are the set of marks upon which the test takers were able to get their names into the participating institute of OUAT entrance exam. After the declaration of the OUAT entrance exam result, the university will release the course-wise passing marks or cutoff.

faqs.question: When will the OUAT 2026 Result be declared?
faqs.answer: The OUAT entrance exam result 2026 will be declared tentatively in the second week of July. It will be declared in the form of scores, percentile and ranks. Candidates have to log in to the official website using their application number and date of birth to check the result. The scorecard will be released a few days after the result declaration. It should be preserved till the admission or counselling process is completed.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of OUAT entrance exam?
faqs.answer: As per the marking scheme for the OUAT entrance exam, each question carries one mark. There is no negative marking scheme. The total marks of the exam is 200.

faqs.question: What documents are required to participate in OUAT counselling?
faqs.answer: Candidates who are invited for counselling and admission are required to submit the following documents in original and two sets of self-attested photocopies before the Admission Board. Intimation letter Downloaded application Form Domicile certificate if relevant (As per clause 2.3.1). Class 10th & 12th Mark sheet and certificates UG Certificate and Mark sheet Master’s Certificate and Mark sheet for Ph. D. admission PwD Certificate In the case of NRI/PIO Candidates all the following documents: Sponsorship Certificate (Annexure- III) Passport of Sponsor Visa/permanent residential certificate of sponsor Residential proof of sponsor(electric bill, water bill, telephone bill etc.) Govt. document or affidavit indicating the blood relationship of candidates with the sponsor Domicile certificate from respective states for Other State Candidates. Medical Fitness Certificate ( Annexure- II). Declaration certificate for discontinued study ( Annexure-IV). CLC, Conduct and Migration Certificate from the Head of Institution last attended. Aadhaar Card with recent photograph. Five passport-size colour photographs.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for candidates who want to apply for OUAT counselling under AFP Quota?
faqs.answer: Candidates applying under the AFP quota shall produce the original Bonafide Certificate issued by Rajya Sainik Board, Govt. of Odisha, Bhubaneswar-2 at the time of counselling and admission, failing which his/her admission to AFP category seat will be denied.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in OUAT?
faqs.answer: No, there is no such procedure to take direct admission in the OUAT exam. Applicants are required to fill the application form and appear in the OUAT entrance exam for their desired course. Since there are two entrance exams OUAT UG & OUAT PG, hence applicants who want to take admission in their desired course need to apply accordingly. The application form, release of admit card, answer key & result will be released in online mode only.

faqs.question: How to get admission to BVSC & AH and BFSc through OUAT entrance exam if a candidate comes from a non-PCB and PCM background?
faqs.answer: Candidates without having Mathematics or Biology will have to make up for their deficiency by taking pre-requisite courses in the subject (Mathematics / Biology) to be offered during the first two semesters. For admission into B.V.Sc & A.H and B.F.Sc. subject combination P.C.B. in + 2 science/equivalent is mandatory. Similarly, for B.Tech (Agril. Engg.), subject combination P.C.M in + 2 science / equivalent are mandatory.

faqs.question: What is the duration of a doctoral programme at OUAT?
faqs.answer: A Doctoral Programme is a full-time study of three years which includes both course work and research for a thesis. The maximum permissible period for completion of the course is seven consecutive academic years for direct students and eight consecutive years for in-service students. An academic year consists of two semesters each having a minimum duration of 110 working days consisting of 95 Net Instructional Days (NID) and 15 examination days.

faqs.question: What is the duration of a Masters degree at Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology?
faqs.answer: A Master’s Degree Programme is a full-time study of two years which includes both coursework and research for a thesis. The maximum permissible period for completion of a Master’s degree is five consecutive academic years for direct students and six consecutive years for in-service students.

faqs.question: Why is OUAT Exam conducted, and why should one should apply?
faqs.answer: OUAT (Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology) is conducts once a year. The OUAT entrance exam is conducted for students who wish to study Agriculture, Horticulture, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Fishery Science, Home Science, and Forestry. Students who wish to pursue undergraduate and Postgraduate courses in these fields should go through the OUAT eligibility criteria, and if they fulfil the criteria, they should appear for the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What to do in case of ragging at OUAT?
faqs.answer: The case of Ragging if any may be reported to respective Deans at the following numbers: Dean, PGF-cum-DRI, OUAT : 0674-2397457 Dean, College of Agriculture, Bhubaneswar: 0674-2397375 Dean, College of Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry: 0674-2397732 Dean, College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology: 0674-2560095 Dean, College of Forestry, Bhubaneswar: 0674-2397766 Dean, College of Community Science: 9437408282 Dean, College of Fisheries, Rangeilunda: 0680-2343235

faqs.question: How many questions are there in Part A and B of OUAT entrance exam?
faqs.answer: There will be 180 general multiple choice questions (Non-crop specific) in part A and 40 crop specific (Field crop and Horticultural crops in equal proportion) questions in part B following the common syllabi of Agriculture and Horticulture faculties. Candidates have to attempt all the questions in part A and any 20 questions from part B.

faqs.question: How many parts are there in OUAT entrance exam for M.Sc (Ag) course?
faqs.answer: The entrance examination for admission into the Master’s programme in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode and for the Doctoral programme is offline at Bhubaneswar. For the M.Sc. (Ag) course programme, the question of entrance test will be comprised of two parts Part- A and Part B.

faqs.question: Are the seats reserved for SC/ST candidates interchangeable in OUAT entrance exams?
faqs.answer: No, the seats that are reserved for SC & ST candidates, who appear for the OUAT Exam and clear the exam, are not allowed to interchange their reserved seats separately.

Candidates applying through CUET need to appear in the Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics sections. During the CUET counselling, candidates have to select the Suresh Gyan Vihar University option.

Candidates can check here complete details about the admission process, application form, exam date, syllabus, pattern and other important information about SGVUEE 2026.
What is SGVUEE?

Suresh Gyan Vihar University Entrance Exam, popularly known as SGVUEE is a National level entrance exam conducted by the Suresh Gyan Vihar University, Jaipur, for admission to BTech and other programmes in the university. The university offers programmes like Diploma/UG/PG/PG Diploma courses in various streams.

blocks.value: SGVUEE Admission Process 2026
Candidates interested in BTech admission to Suresh Gyan Vihar University can find below the complete admission procedure.

Filling the Application Form: Srtudents must fill the application form carefully. Select the program of his/her choice and click on the submit button to proceed to the next page to complete the remaining application process. A system-generated email, mentioning the candidate’s unique student id (SID), 6-digit password and other important instructions will be sent instantly to the e-mail id that's provided.

Application Fee Payment: Having entered the aforementioned information, the candidate then has to pay the application process fee of INR 850. A detail for the mode of payment is as follows: If applying online, candidates can pay the fee online using a Credit Card, Debit Card or through Net Banking If applying offline, candidates can submit a DD (in favour of Suresh Gyan Vihar University payable at Jaipur) or a Challan (generate a copy of the challan form online) that can be deposited at any Axis Bank branch across the country. Users can also deposit the application fee in cash at the University’s Finance Department.

Choosing Center and Slot for SGVUEE: A link will be sent to the candidate to choose the centre and city along with the date & time slot for the entrance test Gyan Vihar School Admission Test (SGVUEE).

Appear in SGVUEE 2026 Exam: Candidates will be required to appear in the test as per the date and schedule chosen by them. The ranks obtained by candidates in the test will be the basis of getting shortlisted for the VGUEEE 2026 counselling.

SGVUEE 2026 Counselling: The information of counselling date to the selected candidate will be sent through SMS/mail. At the time of counselling, a candidate has to bring all original documents along with the latest passport size colour photograph and a DD of Rs 15,000 drawn in favour of “Suresh Gyan Vihar University” payable at Jaipur.
Submission of Documents and Fee Payment: As the last step of admission, candidates will be required to submit all the required documents and the remaining fee at the university on the given date.
SGVUEE Application Form 2026

Suresh Gyan Vihar University releases the application form for SGVUEE 2026 on the university website. The application form will be made available online on the university website as well as offline on the admission office of the university or can be downloaded from the website. Candidates can fill out the application form in both online and offline mode as per their choice.
SGVUEE 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates interested in applying for the BTech course offered at the SGVU can check the programme-wise eligibility criteria in the table below. Candidates must note that there is no age limit for applying to SGVUEE.

value: BTech Computer Engineering BTech Civil Engineering BTech Electrical Engineering BTech Mechanical Engineering

Passed class 12 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of the following subjects- Chemistry / Biotechnology / Computer Science / Biology with at least 60% marks (5% relaxation in case of SC/ST category) in PCM.
Passed class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM) as compulsory subject with minimum 60% marks in aggregate (5% relaxation in case of SC/ST category)

blocks.value: SGVUEE Syllabus 2026

The syllabus of SGVUEE is similar to class 11 and 12 topics of Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Candidates preparing for the exam can study from the topics included in class 11 and 12 board exams. Also, the exam's difficulty is similar to the CBSE class 12 boards. Students should prepare for SGVUEE 2026 accordingly.
SGVUEE Exam Pattern 2026
There will be 90 questions in MCQ format, 30 each from Physics, Chemistry, and Maths. The time duration will be 90 minutes. There will be no negative marks.
SGVUEE Admit Card 2025

The SGVUEE admit card will be released a few days before the exam. The hall tickets will be made available at the university's official website. Upon release, students will have to log in using their application number and password to download.

The hall ticket will have candidate's details such as their name, roll number, application number, exam date and time, venue of the exam centre along with exam day guidelines, and candidates scanned signature and photo and exam day guidelines will be mentioned in the admit card. However, if the exam will be held at the test centre, they will have to carry their admit card along with one government issued valid photo ID proof. If the exam is held as a home-based remote proctored test, candidates will be sent links to the home proctored exam through email.
SGVUEE Result 2026

Suresh Gyan Vihar University released the result of SGVUEE 2026 after a few days of the conclusion of the exam. Results was announced online on the university website. Candidates will be required to login to the website using their application number and password to check their results. Candidates who will be declared qualified will be eligible for admission to the BTech courses in the university.
SGVUEE Counselling 2025

The counselling will be conducted after the announcement of the results. SGVUEE 2026 counselling will be held at the institute campus. All qualified candidates will be required to register to participate in the counselling. The allotment of seats will be based on SGVUEE scores. Candidates who have scored in JEE Main can also participate in the counselling.
Courses Offered

The university diploma, undergraduate, and postgraduate level courses under streams like engineering, science, agriculture, mass communication, commerce, and management. The list of all the courses offered by the university are as below:

Registrations will take place offline and online to offer admissions to MTech courses. Candidates who qualify eligibility must register and submit form before due date.

The deadline for JIIT PGET application form will be available on website along with exam dates. Admission process will be based on scores obtained in JIIT PGET exam. What is JIIT PGET?

Jaypee Institute of Information Technology Post Graduate Entrance Test conducts JIIT PGET exam once a year to offer admission to MTech programmes. Admissions are offered to various programmes like MTech in Biotechnology, Computer Science and Engineering, ECE with specialisations in machine learning and signal processing, etc.

blocks.value: JIIT PGET 2025 syllabus: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology has released the JIT PGET 2025 syllabus . It comprises topics that should be important from the examination point of view. Candidates aspiring for admission through JIIT PGET 2025 must refer to the syllabus before devising their preparation strategy.  Knowing the syllabus will help to keep track of their preparation easily. JIIT PGET syllabus 2025 for different subjects can be seen on this page below. Also, an idea of the JIIT PGET exam pattern is equally important. Further, look into the details of the JIIT PGET syllabus below.
JIIT PGET 2025 Syllabus: MTech Biotechnology
The syllabus for MTech Biotechnology can be seen below.
GENERAL SCIENCE
Biostatistics:

Probability, Major of central tendency and dispersion: Mean, Median, Mode, standard deviation, standard error of the mean, skewness, kurtosis; Testing of hypothesis: Z-statistics, t-statistics, F-statistics, correlation regression, chi-square test
Physics :
Laws of thermodynamics, Concept of entropy, Applications to compression and expansion processes. Solution thermodynamics - Excess properties of mixtures, Concept of free energy,
Chemistry :

Concept of pH and buffer, Chemical bonding and hybridization, Atomic and molecular structure, Chemical reaction equilibrium, Chemical reaction mechanism (SN1 and SN2), Chemical kinetics (first & second order)
Computer Science:
Introduction to logic (binary, decimal, hexa decimal number conversions), Flow diagram
BIOLOGICAL SCIENCES
Biochemistry

Biomolecules and their conformation; Enzyme kinetics; Metabolism (Glycolysis, TCA and Oxidative phosphorylation); Membrane transport and pumps; , Photorespiration;  Mechanism of enzyme action; Enzyme kinetics; Enzyme inhibition; Allosteric enzymes
Cell and Molecular Biology
Cell division; Cell Organelles; Cell Membrane and Cell Wall; Cell cycle, Mitosis and Meiosis; & Molecular controls; Cell signalling: GPCR and Role of second messenger (cAMP);

Central dogma of molecular biology; Structure of DNA and RNA, DNA supercoiling, DNA damage and repair; DNA replication; DNA transcription and RNA processing; Transcription regulation in prokaryotes; Post-transcriptional modification of eukaryotic mRNA; RNA interference; Genetic code and protein synthesis,
Genetics and Developmental Biology
Linkage: concept, linkage maps. Crossing over: concept and significance, Types of mutations, effects of physical & chemical mutagens; Population genetics; Genetic disorders.
Early Embryonic Development in plants and animals: Gametogenesis, Spermatogenesis, Oogenesis; Fertilization (External and Internal): In vitro fertilization; Stem cell (ESC), Amniocentesis.
Immunology

Basic immunology; Cell and molecules involved in innate immunity Adaptive immunity (Cell-mediated and humoral); Antibody structure; Complement system,; Antigen-antibody interactions; Autoimmunity; Hyper-sensitivity; Hybridoma technology; Immunoassays (ELISA and RIA); Monoclonal antibodies in diagnosis and therapeutics; Vaccines.
Introduction to Bioinformatics

Biological databases; Primary, secondary and composite databases; Nucleic acid databases (GenBank, DDBJ, EMBL and NDB); Protein databases (PIR, SWISS-PROT, TrEMBL, PDB); Methods of Alignment (Dot matrix, Dynamic Programming, BLAST and FASTA); Local and global alignment, pair wise and multiple sequence alignments; Similarity, identity and homology of sequences, construction of phylogenetic trees, interpretation of trees.
Recombinant DNA Technology

Restriction and modification enzymes; Vectors: plasmid, bacteriophage and other viral vectors, cosmids, Ti plasmid, yeast artificial chromosome; cDNA and genomic DNA library; Gene isolation; Gene cloning; Expression of the cloned gene; DNA sequencing; Polymerase chain reactions; Reverse Transcriptase-PCR; DNA fingerprinting; Southern and northern blotting; In-situ hybridization; RAPD; RFLP; Site-directed mutagenesis; Gene transfer technologies; Gene therapy.
Basic techniques in Biotechnology

Principle and application of microscopy; filtration; centrifugation; spectroscopy (UV/Visible, NMR, IR), Electrophoresis; chromatography (TLC, HPLC, GC, ion exchange, affinity, gel filtration); lyophilization; Western Blotting.
Microbial & Plant Biotechnology

Microbial nutrition, growth and control; Microbial metabolism (aerobic and anaerobic respiration, photosynthesis); Microbial genetics (plasmids, transformation, transduction, conjugation); Microbial diversity and characteristic features; Viruses; Host-pathogen interactions, role of microbes in industry.

Industrial enzymes; Enzyme immobilization; Types of bioreactors; Bioseparation techniques, Numerical related to Bioprocess technology; Mass Balance calculations, Concept of plant cellular totipotency; Clonal propagation; Organogenesis and somatic embryogenesis, artificial seed, somaclonal variation, embryo culture, in vitro fertilization; Plant products of industrial importance; Plant-microbe interactions.
Biodiversity& Environmental Biotechnology

Importance of Medicinal Plants; Bio-Prospecting and Bio-Piracy, Bioremediation; Biofertilizers; Organic farming, Recycling of bio-degradable municipal, agricultural and Industrial wastes – bio compost making methods, types and methods of vermicomposting, Environmental pollution, GMO’s and related ethical issues, sustainability.
JIIT PGET Syllabus 2025: CSE and all its specializations
Candidates can check JIIT PGET CSE syllabus below -

value: verbal ability and resoning, quantative ability and reasoning, logical connectives, binary logic, logical sequence and matching, seating arrangement, number and letter series, coding and decoding, decision, data interpretation and analysis, analytical reasoning, analogy, assertion and reason, situation and reaction, logical deduction, argument construction, argument evaluation, divergent and lateral thinking, creativity.

number representation, binary arithmetic, boolean algebra, set, relation, function, lattices, probability theory, conditional probability, Baye's theorem, probability distributions, statistics, fundamentals, measurement of central tendency, sampling theory, sampling distributions, matrix manipulation, and linear equation.

processors, primary and secondary memory devices, memory management, I/O interfaces, system and application software, operating system, file systems, DBMS, computer networks, Internet and world wide web.

basic programming in C and C++, basic data structures, arrays, linked lists, trees, graph, fundamental algorithms, sorting and searching, algorithm design techniques, divide and conquer, greedy, backtracking, dynamic programming.
IT applications, e-commerce, Wi-Fi, protection and security, mobile technologies, global trends, general awareness about Indian IT, Indian IT Act and Cyber law, and IT start-up ecosystem.

blocks.value: JIIT PGET 2025 Syllabus: MTech ECE
Electrical Circuit Analysis:

Electrical sources – DC, AC, Voltage, Current and Power Sources, Electrical Components - Passive and Active, Basic Circuit Laws, mesh and nodal analysis. AC waveforms-frequency, phase, amplitude, peak, RMS values and calculation of power. Response of passive components to AC waveforms – impedance. Frequency domain analysis of RLC circuits, resonance, Transient analysis of electric circuits, Steady state analysis of circuits. Network theorems - Superposition, Thevenin, Norton and Maximum Power Transfer. Two port networks. Basic Requirements of Electrical Machines
Analogue Electronics:

Energy Bands in Intrinsic and Extrinsic Silicon; Carrier Transport: Diffusion Current, Drift Current, Mobility and Resistivity; Generation and recombination of carriers; Poisson and continuity equations; Basic Semiconductor theory, PN junctions, PN junction diodes, Zener Diode, Rectifiers and Regulator circuits. BJTs, JFET and MOSFET: characteristics, biasing, different configurations; Single and multistage amplifiers; Amplifiers with different types of feedbacks; Power Amplifiers, Oscillators, differential amplifiers and current mirrors. Op-amps and applications.
Digital Electronics:

Boolean algebra, Logic families. Minimization techniques for Boolean expressions-K-map reduction. Combinational circuits. Sequential circuits. Timing diagram and State diagram. Finite state machines. Semiconductor memories. Wave shaping circuits. 8-bit microprocessor (8085): architecture, programming, memory and I/O interfacing.
Communications :

Elements of communication systems. Random Signals: Random Variables, Autocorrelation, Power Spectral Density. Theory of Modulation and Detection in Analogue and Digital Systems. Sampling and Data Reconstruction; Quantization. Time Division and Frequency Division Multiplexing Techniques. Noise and Its Effect on Communication Systems, QAM, MAP and ML Decoding, Matched Filter Receiver, Calculation of Bandwidth, SNR and BER for Digital Modulation, Line Coding Schemes and Their Power Spectral Density, ISI and Solutions to avoid ISI, GSOP Fundamentals of Information Theory, Introduction to Error Control Coding, Telecommunication Network Model and Switching Technologies, Basics of Mobile Communications and Optical Fiber Communications
Signal Processing:

Signal types and their representation - Time Domain, Frequency Domain. Discrete and Continuous Transforms- Laplace, Fourier and Z- Transforms. Introduction to Systems- Linear and Non-Linear, Continuous and Discrete-time Systems. System Characterization-Time Domain and Frequency Domain. Systems Stability Criterion. DFT and FFT. Digital Filters- FIR, IIR and Filter transformations and implementations. Multi-rate Digital Signal Processing: Decimation & Interpolation, Filter design with sampling rate conversion.
Microelectronics and VLSI Design:

VLSI Design flow, VLSI Circuits and System Representation, CMOS Processing Technology, MOS Transistor Theory, Short Channel Effects, Elements of Physical Design, Logic Design with MOSFETs, CMOS Inverter, Transmission Gate, Analysis of CMOS Logic Gates, VLSI Logic Circuits, Memories and Programmable Logic Circuits
Control Systems:

Basic control system components: Block diagram description, Reduction of Block Diagrams Open Loop and Closed Loop Feedback Systems and Stability Analysis of These Systems Signal Flow Graphs and their use in determining transfer functions of systems Transient and Steady State Analysis of LTI Control Systems and Frequency Response Tools and Techniques for LTI Control System Analysis: Root Locus, Routh - Hurwitz Criterion, Bode and Nyquist Plots, State Variable representation
Electromagnetic s:

EM Spectrum, EM waves and their propagation in different media, Maxwell’s Equations, Plane Waves and Properties: Reflection and Refraction, Polarization, Phase and Group Velocity, Skin Depth, Transmission Lines including Waveguides, S – Parameters, Basics of antennas.

value: Laws of Thermodynamics, Reversible and irreversible systems, Carnot Cycle, Heat Engines, Entropy, Thermal and Chemical Equilibrium
Maxwell’s Equations, Electromagnetic waves, Poynting Vector, Reflection, Refraction, Absorption, and Transmission of Electromagnetic Radiation From Dielectric Surface
Lorentz Transformations, Addition of Velocities, Mass Variation with Velocity, Mass-Energy Relation
Black Body Radiation, Laws of Radiation, Compton Scattering
Heisenberg’s Uncertainty Principle, Schrödinger Equation and Applications, Operators
Origin of Spectral Lines, Angular Momentum, Atoms in Magnetic Field
Vibrational, Rotational, electronic, Raman, NMR and ESR Spectroscopy
Statistical Distributions, Spontaneous and Stimulated Emissions, Laser Action, He-Ne, Ruby and Semiconductor lasers, Optical fibres
Bonding in Solids, Crystal Structure, Crystal Systems, X-Ray Diffraction, Defects and Dislocations
Stress and Strain behaviour, Modulus of elasticity, Yield strength, Tensile strength, Plastic deformation

Free Electron Theory of Solids, Band Theory of Solids, Conduction in Metals, Semiconductors (n and p-type) and Insulators, Ohmic and Non-Ohmic behaviour of materials, Hall Effect in Semiconductors, Transformers, and Superconductivity.

Semiconductor Devices (diodes, junctions, transistors, field effect devices, homo- and heterojunction devices), Device Characteristics, Operational Amplifiers and Their Applications, Digital Techniques and Applications (registers, counters, comparators and similar circuits), A/D and D/A Converters, Basics of Microprocessor and Microcontroller
Polarization mechanism, Dielectric constant, Piezoelectric effect
Dia-, Para-, Ferro-, Antiferro- and Ferri-Magnetic Materials and Their Properties
Lattice Vibrations and Thermal Properties of Solids

blocks.value: PULSE 2026 Registration is ongoing. Candidates can apply for PULSE 2026 either by using the direct link provided below or by visiting the official website, pillai.edu.in . Pillai University will conduct the PULSE entrance exam 2026 for admission to BTech course. .
The Pillai University entrance exam (PULSE) will be conducted only at the university campus exam centre on February 14, February 28, March 7, March 14, March 21, March 28, May 10 and May 24.

Candidates can also attend the exam at other test centres located in Mumbai, Cochin, Varanasi, Dubai and Singapore. The exam date for these centres is May 24, 2026. Candidates have to select their preferred centre while filling the PULSE application form 2026 .
Apply Now => PULSE 2026 Application Form Direct Link
What is PULSE Entrance Test

Pillai University conducts the entrance exam called Pillai University Level Scholastic Exam (PULSE). The exam is conducted to admit candidates to BTech, BDes, BBA, Integrated BBA - MBA, MBA and BCA courses. ­Exam evaluates aptitude, subject knowledge, logical reasoning, and, for design courses, creative abilities. The exam will be held online at the university campus and at the other test centres.
The exam pattern of PULSE test for BTech includes

value: Total 120 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) of 1 mark each
Topics covered are from Physics, Chemistry, General Aptitude, English Proficiency

blocks.value: The duration of the PULSE entrance test is 120 minutes. The exam will be conducted from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
PULSE 2026 Exam Dates
Take a look at the table below for the complete schedule of Pulse 2026 exam
PULSE 2026 Highlights
Check the highlights of PULSE 2026 in the table below.

value: BTech, BDes, BBA, Integrated BBA - MBA, MBA and BCA

blocks.value: There is no negative marking in the entrance test. Candidates can attempt all the questions without the fear of losing marks.
Yes, candidates can select the exam date and centre according to their reference.
PULSE 2026 Registration

The application form of PULSE exam 2026 is open . Candidates can apply online using the link on this page or from the university website. While filling PULSE application form 2026, candidates must enter valid personal, academic and contact details. PULSE 2026 application fee must be paid online, i.e., through net banking/credit card/debit card. Before filling the registration form, candidates must check the official eligibility criteria. Candidates can apply for PULSE 2026 retest by paying the additional fees. The retest will be conducted only in the University Campus Test Centre. Pulse 2026 exam date for retest has to be selected by candidates by login to the website.
Steps to Fill PULSE 2026 Application Form
Candidates must check the eligibility criteria before filling the application form. The basic steps to fill the application form are given below.

value: Click on the register now link on the homepage.
Candidates must register by entering Name, Email ID, Phone Number, Gender, Date of Birth, basic education details, course applying for, communication address.
Next step is to pay the registration fee of INR 1000.
Then fill all the details on the application form and submit it.

blocks.value: ⇒ Fill PULSE Application Form 2026
PULSE 2026 Application Fee
Candidates must pay application fee of INR 1000. The application fee paid is non- refundable and will not be returned at any circumstances.

Candidates can fill PULSE 2026 application form on the official website, pillai.edu.in. The registration link is available on the homepage. Candidates can register, fill the form, upload documents and make the application fee payment.
Candidates must fill the basic personal details, education details, contact details and preferred course details. Candidates must fill all the details correctly to avoid disqualification.
PULSE Eligibility Criteria
The eligibility criteria of PULSE 2026 are given below.
For Undergraduate courses : Candidates who have completed their Class 12/ any other equivalent exam can apply.
For Masters courses : Candidates who have completed or are appearing in the final year exam of their bachelor degree program can apply.
Candidates who have completed or are appearing for Class 12 or equivalent examination. The subject requirement will depend on the course the candidate wants to apply.

Candidates must pay application fee of INR 1000 to submit application form. The Application form will be rejected if application fee is not paid. Application form will be considered incomplete if fee payment is not done.
PULSE Exam Pattern 2026

PULSE 2026 exam pattern is available online on the official website. Details regarding the type of questions, number of questions, total marks etc, can be checked in the PULSE exam pattern. Understanding the exam pattern is necessary for candidates to get good scores in the entrance exam. According to 2026 exam pattern, PULSE will be held as online test for 2 hours . The candidates will have to attempt objective multiple-choice. There is no negative marking for incorrect answers.
Check details of PULSE 2026 exam pattern below.

value: PULSE entrance exam will include total of 100 questions.
All the questions will be Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
Sections included in the question paper are General Aptitude, Language Proficiency, Physics and Mathematics.
Candidates are given 120 minutes to complete the exam.

blocks.value: There is no negative marking in PULSE 2026 .
PULSE 2026 Syllabus

Pillai Univeristy has not published any subject- wise syllabus for BTech entrance test. The subjects included in the exam are Physics, Mathematics, General Aptitude & Language Proficiency topics. PULSE syllabus is based on Class 12 curriculum. Candidates can prepare for the entrance exam by learning from the Class 11 and 12 school textbook.
PULSE Admit Card 2026

Admit card is not required to take the PULSE 2026. Eligible candidates can take the PULSE test 2026 by showing valid Government ID proofs or School/College ID Card at the exam centre . Candidates can check the things allowed in the exam centre below.

value: Valid Government photo ID or School/College ID Card
Rough sheets will be given at the exam centre
Electronic gadgets (phones, smart watches, calculators) are strictly prohibited.

blocks.value: Admit cards are not required. Eligible candidates can take the PULSE test by showing valid Government ID proofs or School/College ID Card at the exam centre.
Candidates will be allowed to take these things to the exam hall.

value: Valid Government photo ID or School/College ID Card
Rough sheets will be given at the exam centre
Electronic gadgets (phones, smart watches, calculators) are strictly prohibited.

blocks.value: PULSE  Result 2026

The PULSE 2026 result scorecard will be sent to the registered email ID of candidates after the completion of exam. Candidates who will score above the minimum qualifying marks will be eligible for admisison.

The authorities will not entertain revaluation request, as the exam is computer based. Candidates must make sure they enter a valid email ID while registering since the result will be sent to the email ID. The candidates will be given admission to various courses based on PULSE score.
PULSE Results will be announced soon after the exam. The exam score will be sent by email.
PULSE dates are released on official website. To know dates, candidates must visit the official website check for the exam schedule link on the homepage.
PULSE Preparation Tips 2026
Candidates can check the preparation tips below.

value: PULSE questions are based on Class 12 syllabus. Therefore, priority must be given to NCERT textbook.
Candidates must focus on definitions, formulas, derivations and examples.
Focus more on understanding the basics rather than memorizing.
Prepare short notes and formula sheets.
Avoid learning new topics in the last minute.
Get enough sleep and stay healthy.

blocks.value: MZUEEE 2026: Mizoram University will soon release the MZUEEE 2026 notification for admission to BTech courses. The MZUEEE Application Form 2026 will be released in March . The Mizroam University Engineering Entrance Examination (MZUEEE) 2026 will be conducted in May . The MZUEEE Exam Date 2026 will be released soon. The MZUEE 2026 exam will be conducted online as well as offline at the university campus and a few other cities across the state. The question paper of MZUEEE 2026 will have multiple choice questions (MCQs) from physics, chemistry, and mathematics of classes 11 and 12. The MZUEEE Syllabus 2026 will be similar to JEE Mains and consists of the standard class 11 and 12 topics covered in the board exam. As per the MZUEEE Exam Pattern 2026 the question paper will consist of 200 questions from all three subjects and the total duration of the exam was 3 hours.  Candidates can read this complete article to get more information about MZUEEE 2026 exam dates, the application process, eligibility criteria, admit card, results, counselling and other details about the admission process in the Mizoram University BTech program.
What is MZUEEE?

The exam body, Mizoram University Engineering Entrance Exam (MZUEEE), conducts the MZUEEE exam every year. The MZUEEE exam is conducted to shortlist candidates for admission into B.Tech programs at the university campus. A total of 50% of seats are filled through the MZUEEE test, while the rest of the 50% are filled through JoSAA/CSAB. Students planning to pursue B.Tech from the university must appear in either the MZUEEE or JEE Main.

The Mizroam University Engineering Entrance Examination (MZUEEE) 2026 will be conducted in May . The MZUEEE Exam Date 2026 will be released soon. The MZUEE 2026 exam will be conducted online as well as offline at the university campus and a few other cities across the state. The question paper of MZUEEE 2026 will have multiple choice questions (MCQs) from physics, chemistry, and mathematics of classes 11 and 12. The MZUEEE Syllabus 2026 will be similar to JEE Mains and consists of the standard class 11 and 12 topics covered in the board exam. As per the MZUEEE Exam Pattern 2026 the question paper will consist of 200 questions from all three subjects and the total duration of the exam was 3 hours.  Candidates can read this complete article to get more information about MZUEEE 2026 exam dates, the application process, eligibility criteria, admit card, results, counselling and other details about the admission process in the Mizoram University BTech program.
What is MZUEEE?

The exam body, Mizoram University Engineering Entrance Exam (MZUEEE), conducts the MZUEEE exam every year. The MZUEEE exam is conducted to shortlist candidates for admission into B.Tech programs at the university campus. A total of 50% of seats are filled through the MZUEEE test, while the rest of the 50% are filled through JoSAA/CSAB. Students planning to pursue B.Tech from the university must appear in either the MZUEEE or JEE Main.
